models.get_user_by_id(post.author_id) if post.author_id else None\n    if user is None:\n        return \"CGE Staff\", ROLE_LABELS[\"admin\"]\n    return user.display_name, ROLE_LABELS.get(user.role, Falls back to the raw date if the stamp\n    isn't the shape SQLite writes.\"\"\"\n    stamp = (post.published_at or post.created_at or \"\")[:10]\n    try:\n        year, month, day = (int(part) for part in stamp.split(\"-\"))\n        return f\"{day} {_MONTHS[month - 1]} {year}\"\n    except (ValueError, IndexError):\n        return stamp\n\n\ndef _initials(name: str) -> str:\n    letters = \"\".join(part[0] for part in name.split()[:2])\n    return letters.upper() or \"?\"\n\n\ndef post_summary(post: models.Post, href: str) -> dict:\n    author_name, author_role = _author(post)\n    return {\n        \"post\": post,\n        \"href\": href,\n        \"title\": post.title,\n        \"excerpt\": markdown.excerpt(post.body),\n        \"topic_value\": post.topic,\n        \"topic_label\": TOPIC_LABELS[post.topic],\n        \"author_name\": author_name,\n        \"author_role\": author_role,\n        \"author_initials\": _initials(author_name),\n        \"published_date\": _published_date(post),\n    }\n\n\ndef children_heading(page: models.Page, home: models.Page) -> str:\n    \"\"\"What to call a Page's list of child Pages, in the reader's words\n    rather than the tree's: Home browses regions, a Continent lists its\n    Countries, a Country lists its Programs.\"\"\"\n    if page.id == home.id:\n        return \"Explore by region\"\n    if models.is_continent_page(page):\n        return f\"Countries in {page.title}\"\n    if models.is_country_page(page):\n        return f\"Programs in {page.title}\"\n    return \"Pages\"\n\n\ndef dispatch_card(post: models.Post, href: str, program_title: str) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"A Post's card outside its own Program page — Home's latest dispatches,\n    a Continent's recent-posts strip, \"More from\" on a Post page — where the\n    reader needs the Program name to place it.\"\"\"\n    return {**post_summary(post, href), \"program_title\": program_title}\n\n\ndef region_index(page: models.Page, home: models.Page, continents: list[models.Page]) -> int | None:\n    \"\"\"Which Continent's accent color governs `page` — None for Home itself,\n    otherwise the index (mod REGION_COUNT) of the Continent that page lives\n    under (or, if `page` is itself a Continent, its own index). Shared by\n    every card and page-header band so a Continent's whole subtree (its\n    Country and Program pages too) reads in one consistent accent color.\"\"\"\n    if page.id == home.id:\n        return None\n    root_id = models.nav_root_id(page, home)\n    for i, continent in enumerate(continents):\n        if continent.id == root_id:\n            return i % REGION_COUNT\n    return None\n\n\ndef program_stats(program_id: int) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Published-post count and the distinct Topic labels present, for a\n    Program's card on its parent Country's listing.\"\"\"\n    posts = models.list_published_posts_by_program(program_id)\n    topics: list[str] = []\n    seen: set[str] = set()\n    for post in posts:\n        if post.topic not in seen:\n            seen.add(post.topic)\n            topics.append(TOPIC_LABELS[post.topic])\n    return {\"post_count\": len(posts), \"topics\": topics}\n\n\ndef page_card(\n    page: models.Page,\n    href: str,\n    home: models.Page,\n    continents: list[models.Page],\n    stats: dict | None = None,\n) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"A Continent/Country/Program's card on its parent's listing: title,\n    href, a short description teased from the Page's own body, its region\n    accent, and — for a Program card — its post count and Topics.\"\"\"\n    return {\n        \"title\": page.title,\n        \"href\": href,\n        \"excerpt\": markdown.excerpt(page.body),\n        \"region\": region_index(page, home, continents),\n        \"post_count\": stats[\"post_count\"] if stats else None,\n        \"topics\": stats[\"topics\"] if stats else None,\n    }\n\n\ndef grouped_post_summaries(\n    posts: list[models.Post], href_for: Callable[[models.Post], str]\n) -> list[tuple[str, str, list[dict]]]:\n    \"\"\"-> [(topic_value, topic_label, [post_summary, ...]), ...], Topics with\n    no published Posts omitted.\"\"\"\n    groups = models.group_posts_by_topic(posts)\n    return [\n        (value, label, [post_summary(post, href_for(post)) for post in group_posts])\n        for value, label, group_posts in groups\n    ]\n","numLines":148,"startLine":1,"totalLines":148}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"24626b2f-5d7f-4c37-8545-d0587ba19bcf","session_id":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

{% endif %}{{ card.published_date }}</span>\n28\t      </span>\n29\t    </div>\n30\t  </li>\n31\t{% endmacro %}\n32\t"}]},"uuid":"3ceb2aae-e9fa-4f62-b1f1-e8f072da522c","timestamp":"2026-10-07T00:25:00.733Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/templates/public/_macros.html","content":"{# Shared public-site building blocks, so a Page and a Post render the same\n   breadcrumb, section heading, and Post card rather than drifting apart. #}\n\n{% macro breadcrumb(items, current) %}\n  {%- if items %}\n  <nav class=\"breadcrumb\" aria-label=\"Breadcrumb\">\n    {% for item in items %}<a href=\"{{ item.href }}\">{{ item.title }}</a><span class=\"breadcrumb-sep\" aria-hidden=\"true\">&rsaquo;</span>{% endfor %}<span class=\"breadcrumb-current\" aria-current=\"page\">{{ current }}</span>\n  </nav>\n  {%- endif %}\n{% endmacro %}\n\n{% macro section_head(title) %}\n  <h2 class=\"section-title\">{{ title }}</h2>\n{% endmacro %}\n\n{# show_topic is off inside a Topic group, where the group heading already\n   names the Topic and a badge would just repeat it. #}\n{% macro post_card(card, show_program=false, show_topic=true) %}\n  <li class=\"card post-card\">\n    {% if show_topic %}<span class=\"post-topic-badge topic-{{ card.topic_value }}\">{{ card.topic_label }}</span>{% endif %}\n    <h3 class=\"post-card-title{% if not show_topic %} post-card-title-first{% endif %}\"><a class=\"card-link\" href=\"{{ card.href }}\">{{ card.title }}</a></h3>\n    {% if card.excerpt %}<p class=\"card-desc\">{{ card.excerpt }}</p>{% endif %}\n    <div class=\"byline\">\n      <span class=\"avatar\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{{ card.author_initials }}</span>\n      <span class=\"byline-text\">\n        <span class=\"byline-name\">{{ card.author_name }}</span>\n        <span class=\"byline-meta\">{% if show_program and card.program_title %}{{ card.program_title }} &middot; {% endif %}{{ card.published_date }}</span>\n      </span>\n    </div>\n  </li>\n{% endmacro %}\n","numLines":32,"startLine":1,"totalLines":32}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"9a91f5cd-fbea-46f2-9a50-0260e4b1820d","session_id":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

Two rules the rubric checks:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft or pending Post, like a\n     draft Page, reaching site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"asia/index.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nimport shutil\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.services import markdown, post_view\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* Kenyon purple plus a warm gold accent; editorial travel-magazine pass, T11.\n   Layout rule this pass enforces: prose always sits in a container (a tinted\n   band, a panel, or a card) and every section announces itself, so no page\n   ends in an unstructured white gap. */\n:root {\n  color-scheme: light dark;\n  --purple: #5B2A86;\n  --purple-dark: #3E1C5E;\n  --purple-light: #F2EBFA;\n  --gold: #C98A3B;\n  --gold-dark: #9C6723;\n  --ink: #1F1626;\n  --muted: #5a5064;\n  --card-border: #E4DCEC;\n  --paper: #FDFBFE;\n  --panel: #FFFFFF;\n  --section-gap: 3.5rem;\n  --topic-general: #5B2A86;\n  --topic-housing: #2E7D6B;\n  --topic-meals: #C9573B;\n  --topic-social-life: #B0538B;\n  --topic-academics: #2E6CA8;\n  --topic-other: #6B6356;\n  /* Region accents: one per Continent (cycles if a 7th is added), used for\n     card top-accents and the interior page-header band. */\n  --region-0: #C98A3B; --region-0-tint: #FBF0DF;\n  --region-1: #2E7D6B; --region-1-tint: #E3F3EF;\n  --region-2: #C9573B; --region-2-tint: #FBE9E4;\n  --region-3: #2E6CA8; --region-3-tint: #E4EEF8;\n  --region-4: #B0538B; --region-4-tint: #FAE9F3;\n  --region-5: #6B6356; --region-5-tint: #F1EEE9;\n}\n* { box-sizing: border-box; }\nhtml { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; }\nbody {\n  font: 16px/1.65 \"Inter\", system-ui, sans-serif;\n  margin: 0;\n  padding: 0;\n  min-height: 100vh;\n  display: flex;\n  flex-direction: column;\n  color: var(--ink);\n  background: var(--paper);\n  overflow-x: hidden;\n  overflow-wrap: anywhere;\n}\nh1, h2, h3 { font-family: \"Fraunces\", Georgia, serif; line-height: 1.2; }\na { color: var(--purple-dark); }\n:focus-visible {\n  outline: 3px solid var(--gold);\n  outline-offset: 2px;\n  border-radius: 2px;\n}\n.wrap {\n  max-width: 72rem;\n  margin: 0 auto;\n  padding: 0 1.25rem;\n}\nmain { display: block; flex: 1 0 auto; padding-bottom: var(--section-gap); }\n\n/* -- header / nav -------------------------------------------------- */\n.site-header {\n  position: sticky;\n  top: 0;\n  z-index: 10;\n  flex-shrink: 0;\n  background: rgba(91, 42, 134, 0.92);\n  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);\n  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);\n  padding: 1rem 0;\n  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);\n}\n.header-inner {\n  display: flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  justify-content: space-between;\n  flex-wrap: wrap;\n  gap: 0.6rem 1.5rem;\n}\n.wordmark {\n  color: #fff;\n  font-family: \"Fraunces\", Georgia, serif;\n  font-weight: 600;\n  font-size: 1.15rem;\n  text-decoration: none;\n  letter-spacing: 0.01em;\n}\n.site-nav {\n  display: flex;\n  flex-wrap: wrap;\n  gap: 0.5rem 1.5rem;\n}\n.site-nav a {\n  color: #E7D9F2;\n  font-weight: 600;\n  text-decoration: none;\n  padding-bottom: 0.2rem;\n  border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;\n}\n.site-nav a:hover { color: #fff; }\n.site-nav a.is-active { color: #fff; border-bottom-color: var(--gold); }\n\n/* -- breadcrumb ------------------------------------------------------ */\n.breadcrumb {\n  font-size: 0.95rem;\n  margin: 0 0 1.25rem;\n  color: var(--muted);\n}\n.breadcrumb a {\n  color: var(--purple);\n  font-weight: 500;\n  text-decoration: none;\n}\n.breadcrumb a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }\n.breadcrumb-sep { margin: 0 0.45rem; color: var(--muted); opacity: 0.7; }\n.breadcrumb-current { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 700; }\n\n/* -- hero (Home only) ----------------------------------------------- */\n.hero {\n  position: relative;\n  overflow: hidden;\n  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple) 0%, var(--purple-dark) 100%);\n  color: #fff;\n  padding: 4.5rem 0;\n}\n.hero::before {\n  content: \"\";\n  position: absolute;\n  inset: 0;\n  background-image:\n    repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) 0 2px, transparent 2px 28px);\n  pointer-events: none;\n}\n.hero-inner {\n  position: relative;\n  display: grid;\n  gap: 2.5rem;\n  align-items: center;\n}\n.hero h1 {\n  font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 4.6vw, 3.25rem);\n  margin: 0 0 1rem;\n}\n.hero-body {\n  font-size: 1.15rem;\n  color: #EDE3F7;\n  margin: 0;\n  max-width: 34rem;\n}\n.hero-cta {\n  display: inline-block;\n  margin-top: 1.75rem;\n  background: var(--gold);\n  color: #2A1240;\n  font-weight: 600;\n  text-decoration: none;\n  padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;\n  border-radius: 999px;\n  transition: transform 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease;\n}\n.hero-cta:hover { background: #E0A861; transform: translateY(-1px); }\n\n.featured {\n  position: relative;\n  background: var(--panel);\n  color: var(--ink);\n  border-radius: 0.9rem;\n  border-top: 4px solid var(--gold);\n  padding: 1.5rem 1.6rem;\n  box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -22px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);\n}\n.featured-label {\n  margin: 0 0 0.75rem;\n  font-size: 0.85rem;\n  font-weight: 600;\n  color: var(--gold-dark);\n}\n.featured-title {\n  font-size: 1.45rem;\n  margin: 0.7rem 0 0.5rem;\n}\n.featured-title a { color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; }\n.featured:hover .featured-title a { color: var(--gold-dark); }\n.featured-excerpt { margin: 0 0 0.9rem; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.95rem; }\n.featured-meta { margin: 0; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--muted); }\n\n/* -- interior page-header band --------------------------------------- */\n.page-header {\n  background: var(--purple-light);\n  padding: 2.25rem 0 2rem;\n  border-bottom: 3px solid var(--gold);\n}\n.page-title { font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 4vw, 2.5rem); It and\nthe static exporter (app/publish.py) share the same page-tree queries in\napp/models.py and the same Markdown renderer, so the two stay in sync.\n\nOnly PUBLISHED pages are reachable here — same rule as the static export.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.publish import CSS\nfrom app.services import markdown, post_view\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\n\ndef resolve(path: str) -> tuple[str, models.Page] | tuple[str, models.Post, models.Page] | None:\n    \"\"\"A Page by its full path, or — one segment further, under a Program —\n    a published Post by slug. Returns None on no match.\"\"\"\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    segments = [s for s in path.strip(\"/\").split(\"/\") if s]\n    current = home\n    for i, segment in enumerate(segments):\n        child = models.get_child_by_slug(current.id, segment)\n        if child is not None:\n            current = child\n            continue\n        if i == len(segments) - 1 and models.is_program_page(current):\n            post = models.get_published_post_by_slug(current.id, segment)\n            if post is not None:\n                return \"post\", post, current\n render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    env = environment()\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    all_pages = models.list_all_pages()\n    chains = {p.id: _slug_chain(p, home) for p in all_pages}\n\n    continents = models.list_published_children(home.id)\n    footer_pages = models.list_footer_pages()\n\n    page_template = env.get_template(\"public/page.html\")\n    post_template = env.get_template(\"public/post.html\")\n\n    for page in all_pages:\n        if page.status != \"published\":\n            continue\n        chain = chains[page.id]\n        active_id = models.nav_root_id(page, home)\n        css_path, nav, footer_links = _furniture(\n            chain, home, continents, footer_pages, chains, active_id\n        )\n        breadcrumb = [\n            {\"title\": a.title, \"href\": _relative_link(chain, chains[a.id])}\n            for a in models.list_ancestors(page)\n        ]\n        is_country = models.is_country_page(page)\n        children = [\n            post_view.page_card(\n                c, _relative_link(chain, chains[c.id]), home, continents,\n                stats=post_view.program_stats(c.id) if is_country else None,\n            )\n            for c in models.list_published_children(page.id)\n        ]\n\n        post_groups = None\n        if models.is_program_page(page):\n            posts = models.list_published_posts_by_program(page.id)\n            post_groups = post_view.grouped_post_summaries(\n                posts, lambda post: _relative_link(chain, chain + [post.slug])\n            )\n\n        intro_md, rest_md = markdown.split_intro(page.body)\n        sections = []\n        if models.is_standalone_page(page):\n            sections = [\n                {\"heading\": heading, \"body_html\": markdown.render(body)}\n                for heading, body in markdown.split_sections(rest_md)\n            ]\n            rest_md = markdown.strip_sections(rest_md)\n\n        html = page_template.render(\n            title=page.title,\n            page=page,\n            intro_html=markdown.render(intro_md),\n            body_html=markdown.render(rest_md),\n            sections=sections,\n            region=post_view.region_index(page, home, continents),\n            css_path=css_path,\n            nav=nav,\n            breadcrumb=breadcrumb,\n            footer_links=footer_links,\n            children=children,\n            children_heading=post_view.children_heading(page, home),\n            post_groups=post_groups,\n        )\n\n        page_dir = out.joinpath(*chain) if chain else out\n        page_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n        (page_dir / \"index.html\").write_text(html)\n\n        if not post_groups:\n            continue\n        for _topic_value, _topic_label, summaries in post_groups:\n            for summary in summaries:\n                post = class=\"hero-body\">Dispatches, field notes, and hard-won advice from Kenyon students on CGE programs around the world.</p>\n          {% if children %}<a class=\"hero-cta\" featured.href }}\">{{ featured.title }}</a></h2>\n            <p class=\"featured-excerpt\">{{ featured.excerpt }}</p>\n            <p class=\"featured-meta\">{{ featured.author_name }} &middot; {{ featured.program_title }} &middot; {{ featured.published_date }}</p>\n          </article>\n        {% endif %}\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  {% else %}\n    <section class=\"page-header{% if region is not none %} region-{{ region }}{% endif %}\">\n      <div class=\"wrap\">\n        {{ ui.breadcrumb(breadcrumb, page.title) }}\n        <h1 class=\"page-title\">{{ page.title }}</h1>\n        {% if intro_html %}<div class=\"page-desc\">{{ intro_html | safe }}</div>{% endif %}\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  {% endif %}\n\n  <div class=\"wrap\">\n    {% if body_html %}\n      <section class=\"section\">\n        <div class=\"panel prose\">{{ body_html | safe }}</div>\n      </section>\n    {% endif %}\n\n    {% if sections %}\n      <section class=\"section\">\n        <ul class=\"card-grid\">\n          {% for item in sections %}\n            <li class=\"card info-card{% if region is not none %} region-{{ region }}{% endif %}\">\n              <h2 class=\"info-card-title\">{{ item.heading }}</h2>\n              <div class=\"prose prose-tight\">{{ item.body_html | safe }}</div>\n            </li>\n          {% endfor %}\n        </ul>\n      </section>\n    {% endif %}\n\n    {% if children %}\n      <section class=\"section\"{% if page.parent_id is none %} id=\"destinations\"{% endif %}>\n        {{ ui.section_head(children_heading) }}\n        <ul class=\"card-grid\">\n          {% for item in children %}\n            <li class=\"card{% if item.region is not none %} region-{{ item.region }}{% endif %}\">\n              <h3 class=\"card-title\"><a class=\"card-link\" href=\"{{ item.href }}\">{{ item.title }}</a></h3>\n              {% if item.excerpt %}<p class=\"card-desc\">{{ item.excerpt }}</p>{% endif %}\n              {% if item.post_count is not none %}\n                <div class=\"card-stats\">\n                  <span class=\"card-stat-count\">{{ item.post_count }} post{{ \"s\" if item.post_count != 1 else \"\" }}</span>\n                  {% for topic in item.topics %}<span class=\"card-stat-topic\">{{ topic }}</span>{% endfor %}\n                </div>\n              {% endif %}\n              <span class=\"card-cta\">Explore &rarr;</span>\n            </li>\n          {% endfor %}\n        </ul>\n      </section>\n    {% endif %}\n\n    {% if post_groups is not none %}\n      {% if post_groups %}\n        <section class=\"section\">\n          {{ ui.section_head(\"Dispatches from \" ~ page.title) }}\n          <div class=\"topic-filters\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Filter by Topic\">\n            <button type=\"button\" class=\"topic-pill is-active\" data-topic=\"all\">All</button>\n            {% for topic_value, topic_label, posts in post_groups %}\n              <button type=\"button\" class=\"topic-pill\" data-topic=\"{{ topic_value }}\">{{ topic_label }}</button>\n            {% endfor %}\n          </div>\n          {% for topic_value, topic_label, posts in post_groups %}\n            <section class=\"post-topic-group\" data-topic=\"{{ topic_value }}\">\n              <h3 class=\"topic-group-title topic-{{ topic_value }}\">{{ topic_label }}</h3>\n              <ul class=\"card-grid card-grid-posts\">\n                {% for post in posts %}{{ ui.post_card(post, false, false) }}{% endfor %}\n              </ul>\n            </section>\n          {% endfor %}\n        </section>\n        <script>\n          (function () {\n            var buttons = document.querySelectorAll(\".topic-pill\");\n            var groups = document.querySelectorAll(\".post-topic-group\");\n            buttons.forEach(function (btn) {\n              btn.addEventListener(\"click\", function () {\n                buttons.forEach(function (b) { b.classList.remove(\"is-active\"); });\n                btn.classList.add(\"is-active\");\n                var topic = btn.getAttribute(\"data-topic\");\n                groups.forEach(function (g) {\n                  g.hidden = topic !== \"all\" && g.getAttribute(\"data-topic\") !== topic;\n                });\n              });\n            });\n          })();\n        </script>\n      {% else %}\n        <section class=\"section\">\n          <div class=\"panel empty-note\">\n            <h2>No dispatches yet</h2>\n            <p>Students on this program haven&rsquo;t published anything so far. %}\n    <section class=\"hero\">\n      <div class=\"wrap hero-inner\">\n        <h1>Study abroad, in Kenyon students&rsquo; own words</h1>\n        <p class=\"hero-body\">Dispatches, field notes, and hard-won advice from Kenyon students on CGE programs around the world.</p>\n        {% if children %}<a class=\"hero-cta\" href=\"#destinations\">Browse destinations &rarr;</a>{% endif %}\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  {% else %}\n    <section class=\"page-header{% if region is not none %} region-{{ region }}{% endif %}\">\n      <div class=\"wrap\">\n        {{ ui.breadcrumb(breadcrumb, page.title) }}\n        <h1 class=\"page-title\">{{ page.title }}</h1>\n        {% if intro_html %}<div class=\"page-desc\">{{ intro_html | safe }}</div>{% endif %}\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  {% endif %}\n\n  <div class=\"wrap\">\n    {% if body_html %}\n      <section class=\"section\">\n        <div class=\"panel prose\">{{ body_html | safe }}</div>\n      </section>\n    {% endif %}\n\n    {% if sections %}\n      <section class=\"section\">\n        <ul class=\"card-grid\">\n          {% for item in sections %}\n            <li class=\"card info-card{% if region is not none %} region-{{ region }}{% endif %}\">\n              <h2 class=\"info-card-title\">{{ item.heading }}</h2>\n              <div class=\"prose prose-tight\">{{ item.body_html | safe }}</div>\n            </li>\n          {% endfor %}\n        </ul>\n      </section>\n    {% endif %}\n\n    {% if children %}\n      <section class=\"section\"{% if page.parent_id is none %} id=\"destinations\"{% endif %}>\n        {{ ui.section_head(children_heading) }}\n        <ul class=\"card-grid\">\n          {% for item in children %}\n            <li class=\"card{% if item.region is not none %} region-{{ item.region }}{% endif %}\">\n              <h3 class=\"card-title\"><a class=\"card-link\" href=\"{{ item.href }}\">{{ item.title }}</a></h3>\n              {% if item.excerpt %}<p class=\"card-desc\">{{ item.excerpt }}</p>{% endif %}\n              {% if item.post_count is not none %}\n                <div class=\"card-stats\">\n                  <span class=\"card-stat-count\">{{ item.post_count }} post{{ \"s\" if item.post_count != 1 else \"\" }}</span>\n                  {% for topic in item.topics %}<span class=\"card-stat-topic\">{{ topic }}</span>{% endfor %}\n                </div>\n              {% endif %}\n              <span class=\"card-cta\">Explore &rarr;</span>\n            </li>\n          {% endfor %}\n        </ul>\n      </section>\n    {% endif %}\n\n    {% if post_groups is not none %}\n      {% if post_groups %}\n        <section class=\"section\">\n          {{ ui.section_head(\"Dispatches from \" ~ page.title) }}\n          <div class=\"topic-filters\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Filter by Topic\">\n            <button type=\"button\" class=\"topic-pill is-active\" data-topic=\"all\">All</button>\n            {% for topic_value, topic_label, posts in post_groups %}\n              <button type=\"button\" class=\"topic-pill\" data-topic=\"{{ topic_value }}\">{{ topic_label }}</button>\n            {% endfor %}\n          </div>\n          {% for topic_value, topic_label, posts in post_groups %}\n            <section class=\"post-topic-group\" data-topic=\"{{ topic_value }}\">\n              <h3 class=\"topic-group-title topic-{{ topic_value }}\">{{ topic_label }}</h3>\n              <ul class=\"card-grid card-grid-posts\">\n                {% for post in posts %}{{ ui.post_card(post, false, false) }}{% endfor %}\n              </ul>\n            </section>\n          {% endfor %}\n        </section>\n        <script>\n          (function () {\n            var buttons = document.querySelectorAll(\".topic-pill\");\n            var groups = document.querySelectorAll(\".post-topic-group\");\n            buttons.forEach(function (btn) {\n              btn.addEventListener(\"click\", function () {\n                buttons.forEach(function (b) { b.classList.remove(\"is-active\"); });\n                btn.classList.add(\"is-active\");\n                var topic = btn.getAttribute(\"data-topic\");\n                groups.forEach(function (g) {\n                  g.hidden = topic !== \"all\" && g.getAttribute(\"data-topic\") !== topic;\n                });\n              });\n            });\n          })();\n        </script>\n      {% else %}\n        <section class=\"section\">\n          <div class=\"panel empty-note\">\n            <h2>No dispatches yet</h2>\n            <p>Students on this program haven&rsquo;t published anything so far. Check the other programs in the meantime.</p>\n          </div>\n        </section>\n      {% endif %}\n    {% endif %}\n\n    {% if latest %}\n      <section class=\"section\">\n        {{ ui.section_head(\"Latest dispatches\") }}\n        <ul class=\"card-grid\">\n          {% for card in latest %}{{ ui.post_card(card, true) }}{% endfor %}\n        </ul>\n      </section>\n    {% endif %}\n\n    {% if recent_posts %}\n      <section class=\"section\">\n        {{ ui.section_head(\"Recent dispatches from \" ~ page.title) }}\n        <ul class=\"card-grid\">\n          {% for card in recent_posts %}{{ ui.post_card(card, true) }}{% endfor %}\n        </ul>\n      </section>\n    {% endif %}\n  </div>\n{% endblock %}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":105,"oldLines":22,"newStart":105,"newLines":5,"lines":["       {% endif %}","     {% endif %}"," ","-    {% if latest %}","-      <section class=\"section\">","-        {{ ui.section_head(\"Latest dispatches\") }}","-        <ul class=\"card-grid\">","-          {% for card in latest %}{{ ui.post_card(card, true) }}{% endfor %}","-        </ul>","-      </section>","-    {% endif %}","-","-    {% if recent_posts %}","-      <section class=\"section\">","-        {{ ui.section_head(\"Recent dispatches from \" ~ page.title) }}","-        <ul class=\"card-grid\">","-          {% for card in recent_posts %}{{ ui.post_card(card, true) }}{% endfor %}","-        </ul>","-      </section>","-    {% endif %}","   </div>"," {% endblock %}"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"a9184f0a-2c29-4ee8-a1ea-5cc906e608b2","session_id":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

%}\n      <section class=\"section\">\n        <ul class=\"card-grid\">\n          {% for item in sections %}\n            <li class=\"card info-card{% if region is not none %} region-{{ region }}{% endif %}\">\n              <h2 class=\"info-card-title\">{{ item.heading }}</h2>\n              <div class=\"prose prose-tight\">{{ item.body_html | safe }}</div>\n            </li>\n          {% endfor %}\n        </ul>\n      </section>\n    {% endif %}\n\n    {% if children %}\n      <section class=\"section\"{% if page.parent_id is none %} id=\"destinations\"{% endif %}>\n        {{ endif %}\">\n              <h3 class=\"card-title\"><a class=\"card-link\" href=\"{{ item.href }}\">{{ item.title }}</a></h3>\n              {% if item.excerpt %}<p class=\"card-desc\">{{ item.excerpt }}</p>{% endif %}\n              {% if item.post_count is not none %}\n                <div class=\"card-stats\">\n                  <span class=\"card-stat-count\">{{ item.post_count }} post{{ \"s\" topic_label, posts in post_groups %}\n            <section class=\"post-topic-group\" data-topic=\"{{ topic_value }}\">\n              <h3 class=\"topic-group-title topic-{{ topic_value }}\">{{ topic_label }}</h3>\n              <ul class=\"card-grid card-grid-posts\">\n                {% for post in posts %}{{ ui.post_card(post, false, false) }}{% endfor %}\n              </ul>\n class=\"hero-body\">Dispatches, field notes, and hard-won advice from Kenyon students on CGE programs around the world.</p>\n        {% if children %}<a class=\"hero-cta\" href=\"#destinations\">Browse destinations &rarr;</a>{% endif %}\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  {% else %}\n    <section class=\"page-header{% if region is not none %} region-{{ region }}{% endif %}\">\n      <div class=\"wrap\">\n        {{ ui.breadcrumb(breadcrumb, page.title) }}\n        <h1 class=\"page-title\">{{ page.title }}</h1>\n        {% if intro_html %}<div class=\"page-desc\">{{ intro_html | safe }}</div>{% endif %}\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  {% endif %}\n\n  <div class=\"wrap\">\n    {% if body_html %}\n      <section class=\"section\">\n        <div class=\"panel prose\">{{ body_html | safe }}</div>\n      </section>\n    {% endif %}\n\n    {% if sections %}\n      <section class=\"section\">\n        <ul class=\"card-grid\">\n          {% for item in sections %}\n            <li class=\"card info-card{% if region is not none %} region-{{ region }}{% endif %}\">\n              <h2 class=\"info-card-title\">{{ item.heading }}</h2>\n              <div class=\"prose prose-tight\">{{ item.body_html | safe }}</div>\n            </li>\n          {% endfor %}\n        </ul>\n      </section>\n    {% endif %}\n\n    {% if children %}\n      <section class=\"section\"{% if page.parent_id is none %} id=\"destinations\"{% endif %}>\n        {{ ui.section_head(children_heading) }}\n        <ul class=\"card-grid\">\n          {% for item in children %}\n            <li class=\"card{% if item.region is not none %} region-{{ item.region }}{% endif %}\">\n              <h3 class=\"card-title\"><a class=\"card-link\" href=\"{{ item.href }}\">{{ item.title }}</a></h3>\n              {% if item.excerpt %}<p class=\"card-desc\">{{ item.excerpt }}</p>{% endif %}\n              {% if item.post_count is not none %}\n                <div class=\"card-stats\">\n                  <span class=\"card-stat-count\">{{ item.post_count }} post{{ \"s\" if item.post_count != 1 else \"\" }}</span>\n                  {% for topic in item.topics %}<span class=\"card-stat-topic\">{{ topic }}</span>{% endfor %}\n                </div>\n              {% endif %}\n              <span class=\"card-cta\">Explore &rarr;</span>\n            </li>\n          {% endfor %}\n        </ul>\n      </section>\n    {% endif %}\n\n    {% if post_groups is not none %}\n      {% if post_groups %}\n        <section class=\"section\">\n          {{ ui.section_head(\"Dispatches from \" ~ page.title) }}\n          <div class=\"topic-filters\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Filter by Topic\">\n            <button type=\"button\" class=\"topic-pill is-active\" data-topic=\"all\">All</button>\n            {% for topic_value, topic_label, posts in post_groups %}\n              <button type=\"button\" class=\"topic-pill\" data-topic=\"{{ topic_value }}\">{{ topic_label }}</button>\n            {% endfor %}\n          </div>\n          {% for topic_value, topic_label, posts in post_groups %}\n            <section class=\"post-topic-group\" data-topic=\"{{ topic_value }}\">\n              <h3 class=\"topic-group-title topic-{{ topic_value }}\">{{ topic_label }}</h3>\n              <ul class=\"card-grid card-grid-posts\">\n                {% for post in posts %}{{ ui.post_card(post, false) }}{% endfor %}\n              </ul>\n            </section>\n          {% endfor %}\n        </section>\n        <script>\n          (function () {\n            var buttons = document.querySelectorAll(\".topic-pill\");\n            var groups = document.querySelectorAll(\".post-topic-group\");\n            buttons.forEach(function (btn) {\n              btn.addEventListener(\"click\", function () {\n                buttons.forEach(function (b) { b.classList.remove(\"is-active\"); });\n                btn.classList.add(\"is-active\");\n                var topic = btn.getAttribute(\"data-topic\");\n                groups.forEach(function (g) {\n                  g.hidden = topic !== \"all\" && g.getAttribute(\"data-topic\") !== topic;\n                });\n              });\n            });\n          })();\n        </script>\n      {% else %}\n        <section class=\"section\">\n          <div class=\"panel empty-note\">\n            <h2>No dispatches yet</h2>\n            <p>Students on this program haven&rsquo;t published anything so far. Check the other programs in the meantime.</p>\n          </div>\n        </section>\n      {% endif %}\n    {% endif %}\n\n  </div>\n{% endblock %}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":104,"oldLines":6,"newStart":104,"newLines":5,"lines":["         </section>","       {% endif %}","     {% endif %}","-","   </div>"," {% endblock %}"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"48ec6256-e21a-4dde-afac-37760d3ae67f","session_id":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

Jinja's\n    HTML autoescaping would turn a child combinator into \"&gt;\" and silently\n    drop those rules, so the preview would stop matching the exported site.\"\"\"\n    _seed()\n    style = client.get(\"/\").text.split(\"<style>\")[1].split(\"</style>\")[0]\n\n    assert \"&gt;\" not in style\n    assert \".prose > :first-child\" in style\n    assert style == publish.CSS","originalFile":"\"\"\"T11 final design pass: the public layout contract.\n\nCovers the things a screenshot would catch but a unit test otherwise would\nnot — the preview and the export sharing one stylesheet, pages having their\nsupporting sections, and the demo catalog reading like real student writing.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport importlib.util\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import models, publish\nfrom app.publish import render_site\nfrom app.services import markdown\n\n_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n\n\ndef _load_seed_demo():\n    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\n        \"seed_demo\", _ROOT / \"scripts\" / \"seed_demo.py\"\n    )\n    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n    spec.loader.exec_module(module)\n    return module\n\n\ndef _seed(client_unused=None):\n    seed_demo = _load_seed_demo()\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    editor = models.get_user_by_email(\"editor@example.test\")\n    programs = seed_demo._seed_pages(admin.id)\n    seed_demo._seed_posts(programs, editor.id)\n    return seed_demo, programs\n\n\n# --- the preview and the export must agree -----------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_preview_stylesheet_is_not_html_escaped(client):\n    \"\"\"The live preview inlines the stylesheet in a <style> block. Jinja's\n    HTML autoescaping would turn a child combinator into \"&gt;\" and silently\n    drop those rules, so the preview would stop matching the exported site.\"\"\"\n    _seed()\n    style = client.get(\"/\").text.split(\"<style>\")[1].split(\"</style>\")[0]\n\n    assert \"&gt;\" not in style\n    assert \".card-grid > .card:only-child\" in style\n    assert style == publish.CSS\n\n\ndef test_exported_stylesheet_link_is_cache_busted(client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"GitHub Pages caches style.css, so a redesign has to arrive under a new\n    URL or returning readers keep the old one.\"\"\"\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n\n    home = (out / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert f'href=\"style.css?v={publish.CSS_VERSION}\"' in home\n    nested = (out / \"asia\" / \"japan\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert f'href=\"../../style.css?v={publish.CSS_VERSION}\"' in nested\n    assert (out / \"style.css\").exists()\n\n\n# --- every page type carries its supporting sections -------------------------\n\n\ndef test_home_leads_with_a_featured_dispatch_and_lists_the_latest(client, tmp_path):\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    home = (out / \"index.html\").read_text()\n\n    assert \"Featured dispatch\" in home\n    assert \"Explore by region\" in home\n    assert \"Latest dispatches\" in home\n    newest = models.list_recent_published_posts(1)[0]\n    assert newest.title in home\n\n\ndef test_continent_and_country_pages_end_with_recent_dispatches(client, tmp_path):\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n\n    assert \"Recent dispatches from Asia\" in (out / \"asia\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    japan = (out / \"asia\" / \"japan\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert \"Recent dispatches from Japan\" in japan\n    assert \"Programs in Japan\" in japan\n\n\ndef test_standalone_pages_render_sections_as_cards_plus_a_way_onward(client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"About CGE and Contact Us keep a compact tinted header and move their\n    body into cards, so neither ends in an empty white page.\"\"\"\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n\n    about = (out / \"about-cge\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    for heading in [\"Advising\", \"Pre-departure and re-entry\", \"Student ambassadors\"]:\n        assert f'class=\"info-card-title\">{heading}<' in about\n    assert \"Latest dispatches\" in about\n\n    contact = (out / \"contact-us\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    for heading in [\"Email\", \"Office\", \"Hours\"]:\n        assert f'class=\"info-card-title\">{heading}<' in contact\n    assert \"cge-demo@kenyon.edu\" in contact\n    assert \"Latest dispatches\" in contact\n\n\ndef test_post_pages_have_an_author_row_a_back_button_and_more_from(client, tmp_path):\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    post_dir = out / \"africa\" / \"kenya\" / \"nairobi-fieldwork\"\n    post = (post_dir / \"fieldwork-notes-are-not-essays\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n\n    assert 'class=\"byline-name\"' in post\n    assert \"Ambassador &middot; Nairobi Fieldwork\" in post or \"Ambassador · Nairobi Fieldwork\" in post\n    assert 'class=\"btn\"' in post and \"Back to Nairobi Fieldwork\" in post\n    assert \"More from Nairobi Fieldwork\" in post\n\n\ndef test_every_public_page_puts_its_breadcrumb_trail_above_the_title(client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"Except Home, which has nowhere to go up to.\"\"\"\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n\n    assert 'class=\"breadcrumb\"' not in (out / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    for path in [\n        (\"asia\", \"index.html\"),\n        (\"asia\", \"japan\", \"index.html\"),\n        (\"about-cge\", \"index.html\"),\n        (\"africa\", \"kenya\", \"nairobi-fieldwork\", \"fieldwork-notes-are-not-essays\",\n         \"index.html\"),\n    ]:\n        html = out.joinpath(*path).read_text()\n        assert 'class=\"breadcrumb\"' in html, path\n        assert 'class=\"breadcrumb-current\"' in html, path\n\n\n# --- the demo catalog --------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_public_bylines_never_show_a_demo_account_label(client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"Seeded accounts are named like students, because their names are the\n    bylines readers see.\"\"\"\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n\n    for html_file in out.rglob(\"index.html\"):\n        text = html_file.read_text()\n        assert \"Ambassador Demo\" not in text, html_file\n        assert \"Staff Demo\" not in text, html_file\n\n    assert \"Maya Chen\" in (out / \"asia\" / \"japan\" / \"kyoto-exchange\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n\n\ndef test_seeded_dispatches_have_distinct_titles_and_spread_out_dates(client):\n    _seed_demo, programs = _seed()\n    posts = [p for program in programs for p in models.list_posts_by_program(program.id)]\n\n    titles = [p.title for p in posts]\n    assert len(set(titles)) == len(titles)\n    assert not any(title.startswith(\"My first week at\") for title in titles)\n\n    published_dates = {p.published_at[:10] for p in posts if p.status == \"published\"}\n    assert len(published_dates) > 5\n\n\ndef test_seeded_dispatches_have_real_substance(client):\n    \"\"\"Each body carries a subheading and a pull quote, so a Post page has\n    something to typeset.\"\"\"\n    _seed_demo, programs = _seed()\n    posts = [p for program in programs for p in models.list_posts_by_program(program.id)]\n\n    assert len(posts) == len(programs) * 3\n    for post in posts:\n        assert \"\\n## \" in post.body, post.title\n        assert \"\\n> \" in post.body, post.title\n        assert len(post.body.split(\"\\n\\n\")) >= 4, post.title\n\n\n# --- the Markdown helpers the layout depends on ------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_split_intro_separates_the_opening_paragraph():\n    intro, rest = markdown.split_intro(\"First para.\\n\\nSecond para.\\n\\nThird.\")\n    assert intro == \"First para.\"\n    assert rest == \"Second para.\\n\\nThird.\"\n\n    assert markdown.split_intro(\"Only one.\") == (\"Only one.\", \"\")\n    assert markdown.split_intro(\"\") == (\"\", \"\")\n    # A body that opens with a section has no intro to lift out.\n    assert markdown.split_intro(\"## Heading\\n\\nBody.\") == (\"\", \"## Heading\\n\\nBody.\")\n\n\ndef test_split_sections_turns_h2_blocks_into_cards():\n    body = \"Intro.\\n\\n## First\\n\\nOne.\\n\\n## Second\\n\\nTwo.\\n\"\n    assert markdown.split_sections(body) == [(\"First\", \"One.\"), (\"Second\", \"Two.\")]\n    assert markdown.strip_sections(body) == \"Intro.\"\n    assert markdown.split_sections(\"No headings here.\") == []\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":45,"oldLines":7,"newStart":45,"newLines":7,"lines":["     style = sharing one stylesheet, pages having their\nsupporting sections, and the demo catalog reading like real student writing.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport importlib.util\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import models, publish\nfrom app.publish import render_site\nfrom app.services import markdown\n\n_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n\n\ndef _load_seed_demo():\n    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\n        \"seed_demo\", _ROOT / \"scripts\" / \"seed_demo.py\"\n    )\n    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n    spec.loader.exec_module(module)\n    return module\n\n\ndef _seed(client_unused=None):\n    seed_demo = _load_seed_demo()\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    editor = models.get_user_by_email(\"editor@example.test\")\n    programs = seed_demo._seed_pages(admin.id)\n    seed_demo._seed_posts(programs, editor.id)\n    return seed_demo, programs\n\n\n# --- the preview and the export must agree -----------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_preview_stylesheet_is_not_html_escaped(client):\n    \"\"\"The live preview inlines the stylesheet in a <style> block. Jinja's\n    HTML autoescaping would turn a child combinator into \"&gt;\" and silently\n    drop those rules, so the preview would stop matching the exported site.\"\"\"\n    _seed()\n    style = client.get(\"/\").text.split(\"<style>\")[1].split(\"</style>\")[0]\n\n    assert \"&gt;\" not in style\n    assert \".prose > :first-child\" in style\n    assert style == publish.CSS\n\n\ndef test_exported_stylesheet_link_is_cache_busted(client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"GitHub Pages caches style.css, so a redesign has to arrive under a new\n    URL or returning readers keep the old one.\"\"\"\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n\n    home = (out / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert f'href=\"style.css?v={publish.CSS_VERSION}\"' in home\n    nested = (out / \"asia\" / \"japan\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert f'href=\"../../style.css?v={publish.CSS_VERSION}\"' in nested\n    assert (out / \"style.css\").exists()\n\n\n# --- every page type carries its supporting sections -------------------------\n\n\ndef test_home_leads_with_a_featured_dispatch_and_lists_the_latest(client, tmp_path):\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / models.list_recent_published_posts(1)[0]\n    assert newest.title in home\n\n\ndef test_continent_and_country_pages_end_with_recent_dispatches(client, tmp_path):\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n\n    assert \"Recent dispatches from Asia\" in (out / \"asia\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    japan = (out / \"asia\" / \"japan\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert \"Recent dispatches from Japan\" in japan\n    assert \"Programs in Japan\" in japan\n\n\ndef test_standalone_pages_render_sections_as_cards_plus_a_way_onward(client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"About CGE and Contact Us keep a compact tinted header and move their\n    body into cards, so neither ends in an empty white page.\"\"\"\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n\n    about = (out / \"about-cge\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    for heading in [\"Advising\", \"Pre-departure and re-entry\", \"Student ambassadors\"]:\n        assert f'class=\"info-card-title\">{heading}<' in about\n    assert \"Latest dispatches\" in about\n\n    contact = (out / \"contact-us\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    for heading in [\"Email\", \"Office\", \"Hours\"]:\n        assert f'class=\"info-card-title\">{heading}<' in contact\n    assert \"cge-demo@kenyon.edu\" in contact\n    assert \"Latest dispatches\" in contact\n\n\ndef test_post_pages_have_an_author_row_a_back_button_and_more_from(client, tmp_path):\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    post_dir = out / \"africa\" / \"kenya\" / \"nairobi-fieldwork\"\n    post = (post_dir / \"fieldwork-notes-are-not-essays\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n\n    assert 'class=\"byline-name\"' in post\n    assert \"Ambassador &middot; Nairobi Fieldwork\" in post or \"Ambassador · Nairobi Fieldwork\" in post\n    assert 'class=\"btn\"' in post and \"Back to Nairobi Fieldwork\" in post\n    assert \"More from Nairobi Fieldwork\" in post\n\n\ndef test_every_public_page_puts_its_breadcrumb_trail_above_the_title(client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"Except Home, which has nowhere to go up to.\"\"\"\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n\n    assert 'class=\"breadcrumb\"' not in (out / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    for path in [\n        (\"asia\", \"index.html\"),\n        (\"asia\", \"japan\", \"index.html\"),\n        (\"about-cge\", \"index.html\"),\n        (\"africa\", \"kenya\", \"nairobi-fieldwork\", \"fieldwork-notes-are-not-essays\",\n         \"index.html\"),\n    ]:\n        html = out.joinpath(*path).read_text()\n        assert 'class=\"breadcrumb\"' in html, path\n        assert 'class=\"breadcrumb-current\"' in html, path\n\n\n# --- the demo catalog --------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_public_bylines_never_show_a_demo_account_label(client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"Seeded accounts are named like students, because their names are the\n    bylines readers see.\"\"\"\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n\n    for html_file in out.rglob(\"index.html\"):\n        text = html_file.read_text()\n        assert \"Ambassador Demo\" not in text, html_file\n        assert \"Staff Demo\" not in text, html_file\n\n    assert \"Maya Chen\" in (out / \"asia\" / \"japan\" / \"kyoto-exchange\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n\n\ndef test_seeded_dispatches_have_distinct_titles_and_spread_out_dates(client):\n    _seed_demo, programs = _seed()\n    posts = [p for program in programs for p in models.list_posts_by_program(program.id)]\n\n    titles = [p.title for p in posts]\n    assert len(set(titles)) == len(titles)\n    assert not any(title.startswith(\"My first week at\") for title in  \"\"\"Each body carries a subheading and a pull quote, so a Post page has\n    something to typeset.\"\"\"\n    _seed_demo, programs = _seed()\n    posts = [p for program in programs for p in post.body, post.title\n        assert len(post.body.split(\"\\n\\n\")) >= 4, post.title\n\n\n# --- the Markdown helpers the layout depends on ------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_split_intro_separates_the_opening_paragraph():\n    intro, rest = markdown.split_intro(\"First para.\\n\\nSecond para.\\n\\nThird.\")\n    assert intro == \"First para.\"\n    assert rest == \"Second para.\\n\\nThird.\"\n\n    assert markdown.split_intro(\"Only one.\") == (\"Only one.\", \"\")\n    assert markdown.split_intro(\"\") == (\"\", \"\")\n    # A body that opens with a section {"parentUuid":"e07eb5d4-49ed-4886-a8da-ff764d984a22","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"7b32bb73-bf8b-455a-97ac-a9dc3ff447f7","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_012LNR8UPbezutbS6vEGaf5m","type":"tool_result","content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Screenshot pages with Playwright, for the design-review passes T11+ ask for.\n\n    uv run python scripts/screenshot.py --out notes/screenshots \\\\\n        --widths 1280 390 \\\\\n        --path / home \\\\\n        --path /asia/ asia\n\nStarts the real app (`app.main:app`) on a throwaway port, waits for it to\ncome up, then drives headless Chromium to capture each --path at each\n--width as \"<name>-<width>.png\" under --out. Pass --login EMAIL PASSWORD to\nauthenticate first (needed for admin screenshots).\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport socket\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nimport time\nimport urllib.request\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n\n\ndef _free_port() -> int:\n    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as s:\n        s.bind((\"127.0.0.1\", 0))\n        return s.getsockname()[1]\n\n\ndef _wait_for(url: str, timeout: float = 15.0) -> None:\n    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout\n    while time.monotonic() < deadline:\n        try:\n            urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=1)\n            return\n        except OSError:\n            time.sleep(0.2)\n    raise RuntimeError(f\"server never came up at {url}\")\n\n\ndef _login(page, base: str, email: str, password: str) -> None:\n    page.goto(base + \"/login\", wait_until=\"networkidle\")\n    token = page.get_attribute('input[name=\"csrf_token\"]', \"value\")\n    page.fill('input[name=\"email\"]', email)\n    page.fill('input[name=\"password\"]', password)\n    page.click('button[type=\"submit\"]')\n    page.wait_for_load_state(\"networkidle\")\n    if token is None:\n        raise RuntimeError(\"login page had no csrf_token field\")\n\n\ndef main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--out\", required=True, type=Path)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--widths\", nargs=\"+\", type=int, default=[1280, 390])","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"ba8346ce-531b-4ea5-a218-03a8ec61a8f2","timestamp":"2026-10-07T00:32:23.603Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Screenshot pages with Playwright, for the design-review passes T11+ ask for.\n\n    uv run python scripts/screenshot.py --out notes/screenshots \\\\\n        --widths 1280 390 \\\\\n        --path / home \\\\\n        --path /asia/ asia\n\nStarts the real app (`app.main:app`) on a throwaway port, waits for it to\ncome up, then drives headless Chromium to capture each --path at each\n--width as \"<name>-<width>.png\" under --out. Pass --login EMAIL PASSWORD to\nauthenticate first (needed for admin screenshots).\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport socket\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nimport time\nimport urllib.request\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n\n\ndef _free_port() -> int:\n    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as s:\n        s.bind((\"127.0.0.1\", 0))\n        return s.getsockname()[1]\n\n\ndef _wait_for(url: str, timeout: float = 15.0) -> None:\n    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout\n    while time.monotonic() < deadline:\n        try:\n            urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=1)\n            return\n        except OSError:\n            time.sleep(0.2)\n    raise RuntimeError(f\"server never came up at {url}\")\n\n\ndef _login(page, base: str, email: str, password: str) -> None:\n    page.goto(base + \"/login\", wait_until=\"networkidle\")\n    token = page.get_attribute('input[name=\"csrf_token\"]', \"value\")\n    page.fill('input[name=\"email\"]', email)\n    page.fill('input[name=\"password\"]', password)\n    page.click('button[type=\"submit\"]')\n    page.wait_for_load_state(\"networkidle\")\n    if token is None:\n        raise RuntimeError(\"login page had no csrf_token field\")\n\n\ndef main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--out\", required=True, type=Path)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--widths\", nargs=\"+\", type=int, default=[1280, 390])","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"e07eb5d4-49ed-4886-a8da-ff764d984a22","session_id":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"98123fe3-9244-48a1-8e7a-1d7a4ac1e79d","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"066ed6e0-76a3-45cc-b7cb-8bee09fd0051","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01JLuD2wtmdQoo63UxN1mFSR","type":"tool_result","content":"150\t# so Staff get a structured layout by writing ordinary Markdown.\n151\tSTANDALONE_PAGES = {\n152\t    \"About CGE\": (\n153\t        \"The Kenyon Center for Global Engagement helps students find a program abroad, \"\n154\t        \"get ready to go, and make sense of it once they are back.\\n\\n\"\n155\t        \"This site is a demo build for IPHS 400 Mini-Project #2, not an official Kenyon \"\n156\t        \"page. The programs, countries, and student dispatches on it are invented, but \"\n157\t        \"the structure matches what a real CGE site would need.\\n\\n\"\n158\t        \"## Advising\\n\\n\"\n159\t        \"Talk through which programs fit your major, what credits transfer, and how a \"\n160\t        \"semester away fits the rest of your degree. Drop in during open hours or book a \"\n161\t        \"longer meeting.\\n\\n\"\n162\t        \"## Pre-departure and re-entry\\n\\n\"\n163\t        \"Required sessions before you go, covering visas, health, money, and safety, and \"\n164\t        \"a smaller one when you get back, where returning students compare notes with \"\n165\t        \"people about to leave.\\n\\n\"\n166\t        \"## Student ambassadors\\n\\n\"\n167\t        \"Students who have already been abroad write the dispatches on this site and \"\n168\t        \"answer questions from anyone considering the same program.\"\n169\t    ),\n170\t    \"Contact Us\": (\n171\t        \"The demo CGE office is modeled on a ground-floor suite in Chalmers Library. \"\n172\t        \"Everything on this page is invented for a class project.\\n\\n\"\n173\t        \"## Email\\n\\n\"\n174\t        \"cge-demo@kenyon.edu\\n\\n\""}]},"uuid":"7ce702e0-e33f-434d-abf2-2923c888b488","timestamp":"2026-10-07T00:41:00.274Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/scripts/seed_demo.py","content":"# so Staff get a structured layout by writing ordinary Markdown.\nSTANDALONE_PAGES = {\n    \"About CGE\": (\n        \"The Kenyon Center for Global Engagement helps students find a program abroad, \"\n        \"get ready to go, and make sense of it once they are back.\\n\\n\"\n        \"This site is a demo build for IPHS 400 Mini-Project #2, not an official Kenyon \"\n        \"page. The programs, countries, and student dispatches on it are invented, but \"\n        \"the structure matches what a real CGE site would need.\\n\\n\"\n        \"## Advising\\n\\n\"\n        \"Talk through which programs fit your major, what credits transfer, and how a \"\n        \"semester away fits the rest of your degree.    moment = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(days=days)\n    return moment.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z\")\n\n\ndef _seed_posts(programs: list[models.Page], editor_id: int) -> None:\n    \"\"\"The three dispatches PROGRAM_POSTS defines for each Program. The one\n    with `author: None` belongs to the seeded editor account and cycles\n    through draft/pending/published across the catalog, so the admin side has\n    a Post in every status to work with (T04); the other two are always\n    published, so every Program page has something to show. Each Post is\n    backdated to its own day, so the public site reads like a term's writing\n    rather than eighteen posts filed at once.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not programs or any(models.list_posts_by_program(p.id) for p in programs):\n        print(\"Posts already seeded (or no programs to seed under), leaving as-is.\")\n        return\n\n    ambassadors = _ensure_fictional_ambassadors()\n\n    for i, program in enumerate(programs):\n        specs = PROGRAM_POSTS.get(program.title)\n        if not specs:\n            continue\n        anchor_status = POST_STATUSES[i % len(POST_STATUSES)]\n        for spec in specs:\n            is_anchor = spec[\"author\"] is None\n            author_id = editor_id if is_anchor else ambassadors[spec[\"author\"]].id\n            status = anchor_status if is_anchor else \"published\"\n            post = models.create_post(\n                program_id=program.id, title=spec[\"title\"], body=spec[\"body\"],\n                topic=spec[\"topic\"], author_id=author_id,\n            )\n            if status in (\"pending\", \"published\"):\n                models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=\"draft\", to_status=\"pending\")\n            if status == \"published\":\n                models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=\"pending\", to_status=\"published\")\n            models.backdate_post(post.id, _days_ago(spec[\"days_ago\"]))\n\n    total = sum(len(PROGRAM_POSTS.get(p.title, [])) for p in programs)\n    print(f\"Seeded {total} dispatches across Topics, authors, dates, and statuses \"\n          \"(draft/pending/published) under the seeded Programs.\")\n","numLines":42,"startLine":650,"totalLines":765}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"5aaca4e2-072b-4af2-8c48-54a14704ee26","session_id":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

Jinja's\n    HTML autoescaping would turn a child combinator into \"&gt;\" and silently\n    drop those rules, so the preview would stop matching the exported site.\"\"\"\n    _seed()\n    style = client.get(\"/\").text.split(\"<style>\")[1].split(\"</style>\")[0]\n\n    assert \"&gt;\" not in style\n    assert \".prose > :first-child\" in style\n    assert style == publish.CSS\n\n\ndef test_exported_stylesheet_link_is_cache_busted(client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"GitHub Pages caches style.css, so a redesign has to arrive under a new\n    URL or returning readers keep the old one.\"\"\"\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n\n    home = (out / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert f'href=\"style.css?v={publish.CSS_VERSION}\"' in home\n    nested = (out / \"asia\" / \"japan\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert f'href=\"../../style.css?v={publish.CSS_VERSION}\"' in nested\n    assert (out / \"style.css\").exists()\n\n\n# --- every page type carries its supporting sections -------------------------\n\n\ndef test_home_has_a_single_column_hero_with_no_dispatch_strip(client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"T11 second follow-up: dispatch strips are Program/Post-only now — the\n    Home hero lost its featured-card second column, and Home no longer lists\n    a site-wide \"Latest dispatches\" strip below it.\"\"\"\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    home = (out / \"index.html\").read_text()\n\n    assert \"Explore by region\" in home\n    assert \"Featured dispatch\" not in home\n    assert \"Latest dispatches\" not in home\n\n\ndef test_continent_and_country_pages_end_after_the_child_cards(client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"T11 second follow-up: no more \"recent dispatches\" strip past the\n    Country/Program cards — a Continent or Country page now ends there.\"\"\"\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n\n    asia = (out / \"asia\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert \"Recent dispatches from Asia\" not in asia\n    japan = (out / \"asia\" / \"japan\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert \"Recent dispatches from Japan\" not in japan\n    assert \"Programs in Japan\" in japan\n\n\ndef test_standalone_pages_render_sections_as_cards(client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"About CGE and Contact Us keep a compact tinted header and move their\n    body into cards, so neither ends in an empty white page. T11 second\n    follow-up: they no longer end with a site-wide \"Latest dispatches\" strip\n    either — a standalone Page's own cards are the full extent of its body.\"\"\"\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n\n    about = (out / \"about-cge\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    for heading in [\"Advising\", \"Pre-departure and re-entry\", \"Student ambassadors\"]:\n        assert f'class=\"info-card-title\">{heading}<' in about\n    assert \"Latest dispatches\" not in about\n\n    contact = (out / \"contact-us\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    for heading in [\"Email\", \"Office\", \"Hours\"]:\n        assert f'class=\"info-card-title\">{heading}<' in contact\n    assert \"cge-demo@kenyon.edu\" in contact\n    assert \"Latest dispatches\" not in contact\n\n\ndef test_post_pages_have_an_author_row_a_back_button_and_more_from(client, tmp_path):\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    post_dir = out / \"africa\" / \"kenya\" / \"nairobi-fieldwork\"\n    post = (post_dir / \"fieldwork-notes-are-not-essays\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n\n    assert 'class=\"byline-name\"' in post\n    assert \"Ambassador &middot; Nairobi Fieldwork\" in post or \"Ambassador · Nairobi Fieldwork\" in post\n    assert 'class=\"btn\"' in post and \"Back to Nairobi Fieldwork\" in post\n    assert \"More from Nairobi Fieldwork\" in post\n\n\ndef test_every_public_page_puts_its_breadcrumb_trail_above_the_title(client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"Except Home, which has nowhere to go up to.\"\"\"\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n\n    assert 'class=\"breadcrumb\"' not in (out / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    for path in [\n        (\"asia\", \"index.html\"),\n        (\"asia\", \"japan\", \"index.html\"),\n        (\"about-cge\", \"index.html\"),\n        (\"africa\", \"kenya\", \"nairobi-fieldwork\", \"fieldwork-notes-are-not-essays\",\n         \"index.html\"),\n    ]:\n        html = out.joinpath(*path).read_text()\n        assert 'class=\"breadcrumb\"' in html, path\n        assert 'class=\"breadcrumb-current\"' in html, path\n\n\n# --- the demo catalog --------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_public_bylines_never_show_a_demo_account_label(client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"Seeded accounts are named like students, because their names are the\n    bylines readers see.\"\"\"\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n\n    for html_file in out.rglob(\"index.html\"):\n        text = html_file.read_text()\n        assert \"Ambassador Demo\" not in text, html_file\n        assert \"Staff Demo\" not in text, html_file\n\n    assert \"Maya Chen\" in (out / \"asia\" / \"japan\" / \"kyoto-exchange\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n\n\ndef test_seeded_dispatches_have_distinct_titles_and_spread_out_dates(client):\n    _seed_demo, programs = _seed()\n    posts = [p for program in programs for p in models.list_posts_by_program(program.id)]\n\n    titles = [p.title for p in posts]\n    assert len(set(titles)) == len(titles)\n    assert not any(title.startswith(\"My first week at\") for title in titles)\n\n    published_dates = {p.published_at[:10] for p in posts if p.status == \"published\"}\n    assert len(published_dates) > 5\n\n\ndef test_seeded_dispatches_have_real_substance(client):\n    \"\"\"Each body carries a subheading and a pull quote, so a Post page has\n    something to typeset.\"\"\"\n    _seed_demo, programs = _seed()\n    posts = [p for program in programs for p in models.list_posts_by_program(program.id)]\n\n    assert len(posts) == len(programs) * 3\n    for post in posts:\n        assert \"\\n## \" in post.body, post.title\n        assert \"\\n> \" in post.body, post.title\n        assert len(post.body.split(\"\\n\\n\")) >= 4, post.title\n\n\n# --- the Markdown helpers the layout depends on ------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_split_intro_separates_the_opening_paragraph():\n    intro, rest = markdown.split_intro(\"First para.\\n\\nSecond para.\\n\\nThird.\")\n    assert intro == \"First para.\"\n    assert rest == \"Second para.\\n\\nThird.\"\n\n    assert markdown.split_intro(\"Only one.\") == (\"Only one.\", \"\")\n    assert markdown.split_intro(\"\") == (\"\", \"\")\n    # A body that opens with a section has no intro to lift out.\n    assert markdown.split_intro(\"## Heading\\n\\nBody.\") == (\"\", \"## Heading\\n\\nBody.\")\n\n\ndef test_split_sections_turns_h2_blocks_into_cards():\n    body = \"Intro.\\n\\n## First\\n\\nOne.\\n\\n## Second\\n\\nTwo.\\n\"\n    assert markdown.split_sections(body) == [(\"First\", \"One.\"), (\"Second\", \"Two.\")]\n    assert markdown.strip_sections(body) == Jinja's\n    HTML autoescaping would turn a child combinator into \"&gt;\" and silently\n    drop those rules, so the preview would stop matching the exported site.\"\"\"\n    _seed()\n    style = client.get(\"/\").text.split(\"<style>\")[1].split(\"</style>\")[0]\n\n    assert \"&gt;\" not in style\n    assert \".prose > :first-child\" in style\n    assert style == publish.CSS\n\n\ndef test_exported_stylesheet_link_is_cache_busted(client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"GitHub Pages caches style.css, so a redesign has to arrive under a new\n    URL or returning readers keep the old one.\"\"\"\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n\n    home = (out / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert f'href=\"style.css?v={publish.CSS_VERSION}\"' in home\n    nested = (out / \"asia\" / \"japan\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert f'href=\"../../style.css?v={publish.CSS_VERSION}\"' in nested\n    assert (out / \"style.css\").exists()\n\n\n# --- every page type carries its supporting sections -------------------------\n\n\ndef test_home_has_a_single_column_hero_with_no_dispatch_strip(client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"T11 second follow-up: dispatch strips are Program/Post-only now — the\n    Home hero lost its featured-card second column, and Home no longer lists\n    a site-wide \"Latest dispatches\" strip below it.\"\"\"\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    home = (out / \"index.html\").read_text()\n\n    assert \"Explore by region\" in home\n    assert \"Featured dispatch\" not in home\n    assert \"Latest dispatches\" not in home\n\n\ndef test_continent_and_country_pages_end_after_the_child_cards(client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"T11 second follow-up: no more \"recent dispatches\" strip past the\n    Country/Program cards — a Continent or Country page now ends there.\"\"\"\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n\n    asia = (out / \"asia\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert \"Recent dispatches from Asia\" not in asia\n    japan = (out / \"asia\" / \"japan\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert \"Recent dispatches from Japan\" not in japan\n    assert \"Programs in Japan\" in japan\n\n\ndef test_standalone_pages_render_sections_as_cards(client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"About CGE and Contact Us keep a compact tinted header and move their\n    body into cards, so neither ends in an empty white page. T11 second\n    follow-up: they no longer end with a site-wide \"Latest dispatches\" strip\n    either — a standalone Page's own cards are the full extent of its body.\"\"\"\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n\n    about = (out / \"about-cge\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    for heading in [\"Advising\", \"Pre-departure and re-entry\", \"Student ambassadors\"]:\n        assert f'class=\"info-card-title\">{heading}<' in about\n    assert \"Latest dispatches\" not in about\n\n    contact = (out / \"contact-us\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    for heading in [\"Email\", \"Office\", \"Hours\"]:\n        assert f'class=\"info-card-title\">{heading}<' in contact\n    assert \"cge-demo@kenyon.edu\" in contact\n    assert \"Latest dispatches\" not in contact\n\n\ndef test_post_pages_have_an_author_row_a_back_button_and_more_from(client, tmp_path):\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    post_dir = out / \"africa\" / \"kenya\" / \"nairobi-fieldwork\"\n    post = (post_dir / \"fieldwork-notes-are-not-essays\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n\n    assert 'class=\"byline-name\"' in post\n    assert \"Ambassador &middot; Nairobi Fieldwork\" in post or \"Ambassador · Nairobi Fieldwork\" in post\n    assert 'class=\"btn\"' in post and \"Back to Nairobi Fieldwork\" in post\n    assert \"More from Nairobi Fieldwork\" in post\n\n\ndef test_every_public_page_puts_its_breadcrumb_trail_above_the_title(client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"Except Home, which has nowhere to go up to.\"\"\"\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n\n    assert 'class=\"breadcrumb\"' not in (out / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    for path in [\n        (\"asia\", \"index.html\"),\n        (\"asia\", \"japan\", \"index.html\"),\n        (\"about-cge\", \"index.html\"),\n        (\"africa\", \"kenya\", \"nairobi-fieldwork\", \"fieldwork-notes-are-not-essays\",\n         \"index.html\"),\n    ]:\n        html = out.joinpath(*path).read_text()\n        assert 'class=\"breadcrumb\"' in html, path\n        assert 'class=\"breadcrumb-current\"' in html, path\n\n\n# --- the demo catalog --------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_public_bylines_never_show_a_demo_account_label(client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"Seeded accounts are named like students, because their names are the\n    bylines readers see.\"\"\"\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n\n    for html_file in out.rglob(\"index.html\"):\n        text = html_file.read_text()\n        assert \"Ambassador Demo\" not in text, html_file\n        assert \"Staff Demo\" not in text, html_file\n\n    assert \"Maya Chen\" in (out / \"asia\" / \"japan\" / \"kyoto-exchange\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n\n\ndef test_seeded_posts_have_distinct_titles_and_spread_out_dates(client):\n    _seed_demo, programs = _seed()\n    posts = [p for program in programs for p in models.list_posts_by_program(program.id)]\n\n    titles = [p.title for p in posts]\n    assert len(set(titles)) == len(titles)\n    assert not any(title.startswith(\"My first week at\") for title in titles)\n\n    published_dates = {p.published_at[:10] for p in posts if p.status == \"published\"}\n    assert len(published_dates) > 5\n\n\ndef test_seeded_dispatches_have_real_substance(client):\n    \"\"\"Each body carries a subheading and a pull quote, so a Post page has\n    something to typeset.\"\"\"\n    _seed_demo, programs = _seed()\n    posts = [p for program in programs for p in models.list_posts_by_program(program.id)]\n\n    assert len(posts) == len(programs) * 3\n    for post in posts:\n        assert \"\\n## \" in post.body, post.title\n        assert \"\\n> \" in post.body, post.title\n        assert len(post.body.split(\"\\n\\n\")) >= 4, post.title\n\n\n# --- the Markdown helpers the layout depends on ------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_split_intro_separates_the_opening_paragraph():\n    intro, rest = markdown.split_intro(\"First para.\\n\\nSecond para.\\n\\nThird.\")\n    assert intro == \"First para.\"\n    assert rest == \"Second para.\\n\\nThird.\"\n\n    assert markdown.split_intro(\"Only one.\") == (\"Only one.\", \"\")\n    assert markdown.split_intro(\"\") == (\"\", \"\")\n    # A body that opens with a section has no intro to lift out.\n    assert markdown.split_intro(\"## Heading\\n\\nBody.\") == (\"\", \"## Heading\\n\\nBody.\")\n\n\ndef test_split_sections_turns_h2_blocks_into_cards():\n    body = \"Intro.\\n\\n## First\\n\\nOne.\\n\\n## Second\\n\\nTwo.\\n\"\n    assert markdown.split_sections(body) == [(\"First\", \"One.\"), (\"Second\", \"Two.\")]\n    assert markdown.strip_sections(body) == \"Intro.\"\n    assert markdown.split_sections(\"No headings here.\") == []\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":170,"oldLines":7,"newStart":170,"newLines":7,"lines":["     assert len(published_dates) > The two surviving \"more from Program\" use sites (Program page's own listing, Post page's \"More from X\") correctly switched from `dispatch_card(other, href, title)` to plain `post_summary(other, href)` in both `app/publish.py:660-666` and `app/routes/public.py:112-116`/`post_context`, with `program_title` passed only as a page-level template variable (`templates/public/post.html:13,23,28`), never re-attached to a card dict. The new `:has()` CSS rule in `app/publish.py:269-273` is syntactically valid, and its interaction with the `@media (max-width: 30rem)` single-column override, while technically higher-specificity, produces no visible breakage because `auto-fit` with a `minmax(16rem, 22rem)` track still collapses to one column at narrow widths given typical `.wrap` padding. For a 1-or-2-card grid at ≤30rem viewport width, the `:has()` rule wins outright, making that mobile rule dead code for that case. In practice this doesn't visibly break anything — `auto-fit` with `minmax(16rem, 22rem)` still only fits one track in a ~22rem-wide mobile content area, so the rendered result is a single, slightly narrower (≤22rem vs. full-width) centered column rather than a broken multi-column layout. This is fine as a substitution, just noting it's intentionally arbitrary rather than semantically tied to the diff.\n\nNo dangling references to `list_recent_published_posts`, `list_published_posts_under`, `dispatch_card`, `.featured`, or the `featured`/`latest`/`recent_posts` template variables were found anywhere in the tracked tree (excluding the explicitly out-of-scope notes files, which only mention \"dispatch\" in historical/narrative context).
