{"parentUuid":"8930ed87-0bcb-4e94-a535-68c772b07550","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011CfmxG7kB3xTSiieZEHU3m","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_014SJeatpxcrFqwYmDxFv1TZ","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cat > /tmp/claude-1000/-home-adam-leider-code-iphs400-mp2-cms/882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d/scratchpad/issue12-comment2.md << 'EOF'\n## Design change: remove dispatch strips outside Program/Post pages\n\nPulled back three sections added in the last follow-up, per design feedback:\nremoved the \"Featured dispatch\" card from the Home hero, the \"Latest\ndispatches\" strip on Home and on standalone pages (About CGE, Contact Us),\nand the \"Recent dispatches from {region}\" strip on Continent/Country pages.\nKept the Program page's own post listing and the Post page's \"More from\n{Program}\" section — those stay the only places posts surface outside their\nown Program.\n\n### Spacing fixes from the removal\n- **Home hero**: was a two-column grid (headline/pitch + featured card).\n  With the card gone, rebuilt it as a single centered column, capped at\n  36rem, with reduced padding — no empty second half, no oversized dark\n  gradient area.\n- **Continent/Country pages**: now end right after the child-card grid. Added\n  a CSS `:has()` rule so a grid of exactly 1 or 2 cards (a Continent with one\n  Country, a Country with one Program) is capped in width and centered\n  instead of stretching full-bleed or sitting left-aligned with empty space\n  beside it. Grids with 3+ items are unaffected — still fill the row the way\n  the first design pass intended. Verified visually (screenshots below); the\n  existing flex-based sticky footer already keeps a short page from leaving\n  a dead gap above it, so no extra change was needed there.\n\n### Code removed\n`models.list_recent_published_posts`, `models.list_published_posts_under`,\n`post_view.dispatch_card` (and `app/routes/public.py`'s and\n`app/publish.py`'s card-building closures around them), the `.featured*`\nCSS rules, and the `_macros.html` `post_card` macro's now-unused\n`show_program` parameter. Both the live-preview route and the static\nexporter were updated in lockstep (they duplicate this page-building logic\nand need to stay in sync).\n\n### Unrelated finding fixed in the same pass\nWhile re-reading the templates I found `notes/report-notes.md` already had a\nnote from an earlier session: Claude had drifted into calling Posts\n\"dispatches\" in UI copy (hero, footer, headings), which isn't in CONTEXT.md's\nvocabulary (\"Post\" only) and had already been corrected once. Some of that\nwording had crept back in during the last design pass (hero pitch, footer\ntagline, the Program page's section heading, an empty-state message, and\n`scripts/seed_demo.py`'s comments/print output). Renamed all of it back to\n\"Post\"/\"posts\" in this same commit, flagged to the project owner before\ndoing it.\n\n### Review\nFresh foreground subagent review of this diff (not a re-review of the whole\nissue): no blocking issues. One informational note — the new `:has()`\ncard-grid rule technically outranks the `@media (max-width: 30rem)`\nsingle-column override in specificity, so on very narrow viewports it's the\n`:has()` rule, not the media query, that ends up governing a 1-2 card grid.\nNo visible effect (confirmed by screenshot at 390px — still a single,\ncentered column, no overflow), just worth knowing if either rule changes\nlater.\n\n### Verification\nScreenshotted Home, a Continent (Asia), a Country (Japan), a Program (Kyoto\nExchange), and a Post at 1280px and 390px with `scripts/screenshot.py` and\nreviewed each — hero, card grids, and page endings all read as intended, no\nhorizontal scroll. `uv run pytest -q` → 164 passed. `uv run python\nscripts/check_submission.py --stage 1` → 11/12 (the pre-existing \"no secrets\nin history\" failure is unrelated, out of scope).\nEOF\ngh issue comment 12 --body-file {"parentUuid":"4b14455e-f4a6-44a2-9883-5d8e2281fd92","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"64239083-c66a-4955-99a7-d35d1d813ada","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01YGFb3yFAx9Mf3hzpQNy3Y9","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n2\t\n3\tT00 (already done): the admin console answers at /admin and the public site\n4\tanswers at /. That is the whole skeleton — it exists so you can prove the stack\n5\truns before you build anything on it.\n6\t\n7\tAdd your routes in their own modules (app/routes/posts.py and so on) and include\n8\tthem here. Keep this file small.\n9\t\"\"\"\n10\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n11\t\n12\tfrom fastapi import FastAPI, Request\n13\tfrom fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\n14\tfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n15\t\n16\tfrom app import db, settings\n17\tfrom app.routes import accounts, auth, console, pages, posts, public\n18\tfrom app.routes.auth import AdminRequired, CsrfInvalid, LoginRequired\n19\t\n20\t\n21\tdef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n22\t    db.init_db()\n23\t    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\")\n24\t    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n25\t                        session_cookie=\"cms_session\")\n26\t\n27\t    @app.exception_handler(LoginRequired)\n28\t    def _login_required(request: Request, exc: LoginRequired):\n29\t        return RedirectResponse(url=\"/login\", status_code=303)\n30\t\n31\t    @app.exception_handler(AdminRequired)\n32\t    def _admin_required(request: Request, exc: AdminRequired):\n33\t        return PlainTextResponse(\"Forbidden\", status_code=403)\n34\t\n35\t    @app.exception_handler(CsrfInvalid)\n36\t    def _csrf_invalid(request: Request, exc: CsrfInvalid):\n37\t        return PlainTextResponse(\"Forbidden: missing or invalid CSRF token\", status_code=403)\n38\t\n39\t    app.include_router(auth.router)\n40\t    app.include_router(pages.router)\n41\t    app.include_router(posts.router)\n42\t    app.include_router(accounts.router)\n43\t    app.include_router(console.router)\n44\t\n45\t    # Catch-all last: the live public site, read straight from the database —"}]},"uuid":"52ad0f6e-5d37-4940-acf1-66169a2115d8","timestamp":"2026-10-07T01:04:50.712Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/main.py","content":"\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n\nT00 (already done): the admin console answers at /admin and the public site\nanswers at /. That is the whole skeleton — it exists so you can prove the stack\nruns before you build anything on it.\n\nAdd your routes in their own modules (app/routes/posts.py and so on) and include\nthem here. Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import FastAPI, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import db, settings\nfrom app.routes import accounts, auth, console, pages, posts, public\nfrom app.routes.auth import AdminRequired, CsrfInvalid, LoginRequired\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    db.init_db()\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\")\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                        session_cookie=\"cms_session\")\n\n    @app.exception_handler(LoginRequired)\n    def _login_required(request: Request, exc: LoginRequired):\n        return RedirectResponse(url=\"/login\", status_code=303)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(AdminRequired)\n    def _admin_required(request: Request, exc: AdminRequired):\n        return PlainTextResponse(\"Forbidden\", status_code=403)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(CsrfInvalid)\n    def _csrf_invalid(request: Request, exc: CsrfInvalid):\n        return PlainTextResponse(\"Forbidden: missing or invalid CSRF token\", status_code=403)\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(pages.router)\n    app.include_router(posts.router)\n    app.include_router(accounts.router)\n    app.include_router(console.router)\n\n    # Catch-all last: the live public site, read straight from the database —","numLines":45,"startLine":1,"totalLines":52}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"4b14455e-f4a6-44a2-9883-5d8e2281fd92","session_id":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout\n    while time.monotonic() < deadline:\n        try:\n            urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=1)\n            return\n        except OSError:\n default=[], dest=\"paths\", help=\"repeatable: a URL path and a filename stem\",\n    )\n    parser.add_argument(\n        \"--login\", nargs=2, metavar=(\"EMAIL\", \"PASSWORD\"), default=None,\n args.out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    port = _free_port()\n    base = f\"http://127.0.0.1:{port}\"\n\n    server = subprocess.Popen(\n        [sys.executable, \"-m\", \"uvicorn\", \"app.main:app\", \"--port\", str(port)],\n        cwd=ROOT,\n    )\n    try:\n        _wait_for(base + \"/\")\n        with sync_playwright() as p:\n            browser = p.chromium.launch()\n            for width in args.widths:\n                context = browser.new_context(viewport={\"width\": width, \"height\": 900})\n                page = context.new_page()\n                if args.login:\n         server.wait(timeout=10)\n        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:\n            server.kill()\n            server.wait(timeout=10)\n\n    print(f\"Saved screenshots to {args.out}\")\n {"parentUuid":"5513763b-e119-423c-8b96-61edd78db96c","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011CfmypmDBg26vgry7g9AJw","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I captured all 12, but the admin console renders **completely unstyled** — raw browser-default HTML, no CSS at all. {"parentUuid":"7b46c1ea-8d04-44a7-bcee-f3bd7ca1d1cf","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"64239083-c66a-4955-99a7-d35d1d813ada","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01J8vBTXgBPAML3A5DYeWN4U","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t# Issue tracker: GitHub\n2\t\n3\tIssues and specs for this repo live as GitHub issues. Use the `gh` CLI for all operations.\n4\t\n5\t## Conventions\n6\t\n7\t- **Create an issue**: `gh issue create --title \"...\" --body \"...\"`. Use a heredoc for multi-line bodies.\n8\t- **Read an issue**: `gh issue view <number> --comments`, filtering comments by `jq` and also fetching labels.\n9\t- **List issues**: `gh issue list --state open --json number,title,body,labels,comments --jq '[.[] | {number, title, body, labels: [.labels[].name], comments: [.comments[].body]}]'` with appropriate `--label` and `--state` filters.\n10\t- **Comment on an issue**: `gh issue comment <number> --body \"...\"`\n11\t- **Apply / remove labels**: `gh issue edit <number> --add-label \"...\"` / `--remove-label \"...\"`\n12\t- **Close**: `gh issue close <number> --comment \"...\"`\n13\t\n14\tInfer the repo from `git remote -v`; `gh` does this automatically when run inside a clone.\n15\t\n16\t## Pull requests as a triage surface\n17\t\n18\t**PRs as a request surface: no.** _(Set to `yes` if this repo treats external PRs as feature requests; `/triage` reads this flag.)_\n19\t\n20\tWhen set to `yes`, PRs run through the same labels and states as issues, using the `gh pr` equivalents:\n21\t\n22\t- **Read a PR**: `gh pr view <number> --comments` and `gh pr diff <number>` for the diff.\n23\t- **List external PRs for triage**: `gh pr list --state open --json number,title,body,labels,author,authorAssociation,comments` then keep only `authorAssociation` of `CONTRIBUTOR`, `FIRST_TIME_CONTRIBUTOR`, or `NONE` (drop `OWNER`/`MEMBER`/`COLLABORATOR`).\n24\t- **Comment / label / close**: `gh pr comment`, `gh pr edit --add-label`/`--remove-label`, `gh pr close`.\n25\t\n26\tGitHub shares one number space across issues and PRs, so a bare `#42` may be either: resolve with `gh pr view 42` and fall back to `gh issue view 42`.\n27\t\n28\t## When a skill says \"publish to the issue tracker\"\n29\t\n30\tCreate a GitHub issue.\n31\t\n32\t## When a skill says \"fetch the relevant ticket\"\n33\t\n34\tRun `gh issue view <number> --comments`.\n35\t\n36\t## Wayfinding operations\n37\t\n38\tUsed by `/wayfinder`. The **map** is a single issue with **child** issues as tickets.\n39\t\n40\t- **Map**: a single issue labelled `wayfinder:map`, holding the Notes / Decisions-so-far / Fog body. `gh issue create --label wayfinder:map`.\n41\t- **Child ticket**: an issue linked to the map as a GitHub sub-issue (`gh api` on the sub-issues endpoint). Where sub-issues aren't enabled, add the child to a task list in the map body and put `Part of #<map>` at the top of the child body. Labels: `wayfinder:<type>` (`research`/`prototype`/`grilling`/`task`). Once claimed, the ticket is assigned to the driving dev.\n42\t- **Blocking**: GitHub's **native issue dependencies**, the canonical, UI-visible representation. Add an edge with `gh api --method POST repos/<owner>/<repo>/issues/<child>/dependencies/blocked_by -F issue_id=<blocker-db-id>`, where `<blocker-db-id>` is the blocker's numeric **database id** (`gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/issues/<n> --jq .id`, _not_ the `#number` or `node_id`). GitHub reports `issue_dependencies_summary.blocked_by` (open blockers only, the live gate). Where dependencies aren't available, fall back to a `Blocked by: #<n>, #<n>` line at the top of the child body. A ticket is unblocked when every blocker is closed.\n43\t- **Frontier query**: list the map's open children (`gh issue list --state open`, scoped to the map's sub-issues / task list), drop any with an open blocker (`issue_dependencies_summary.blocked_by > 0`, or an open issue in the `Blocked by` line) or an assignee; first in map order wins.\n44\t- **Claim**: `gh issue edit <n> --add-assignee @me`, the session's first write.\n45\t- **Resolve**: `gh issue comment <n> --body \"<answer>\"`, then `gh issue close <n>`, then append a context pointer (gist + link) to the map's Decisions-so-far.\n46\t"}]},"uuid":"44a2b148-8dec-456d-ad1e-15cb89f5b9f3","timestamp":"2026-10-07T01:07:38.140Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/docs/agents/issue-tracker.md","content":"# Issue tracker: GitHub\n\nIssues and specs for this repo live as GitHub issues. Use the `gh` CLI for all operations.\n\n## Conventions\n\n- **Create an issue**: `gh issue create --title \"...\" --body \"...\"`. Use a heredoc for multi-line bodies.\n- **Read an issue**: `gh issue view <number> --comments`, filtering comments by `jq` and also fetching labels.\n- **List issues**: `gh issue list --state open --json number,title,body,labels,comments --jq '[.[] | {number, title, body, labels: [.labels[].name], comments: [.comments[].body]}]'` with appropriate `--label` and `--state` filters.\n- **Comment on an issue**: `gh issue comment <number> --body \"...\"`\n- **Apply / remove labels**: `gh issue edit <number> --add-label \"...\"` / `--remove-label \"...\"`\n- **Close**: `gh issue close <number> --comment \"...\"`\n\nInfer the repo from `git remote -v`; `gh` does this automatically when run inside a clone.\n\n## Pull requests as a triage surface\n\n**PRs as a request surface: no.** _(Set to `yes` if this repo treats external PRs as feature requests; `/triage` reads this flag.)_\n\nWhen set to `yes`, PRs run through the same labels and states as issues, using the `gh pr` equivalents:\n\n- **Read a PR**: `gh pr view <number> --comments` and `gh pr diff <number>` for the diff.\n- **List external PRs for triage**: `gh pr list --state open --json number,title,body,labels,author,authorAssociation,comments` then keep only `authorAssociation` of `CONTRIBUTOR`, `FIRST_TIME_CONTRIBUTOR`, or `NONE` (drop `OWNER`/`MEMBER`/`COLLABORATOR`).\n- **Comment / label / close**: `gh pr comment`, `gh pr edit --add-label`/`--remove-label`, `gh pr close`.\n\nGitHub shares one number space across issues and PRs, so a bare `#42` may be either: resolve with `gh pr view 42` and fall back to `gh issue view 42`.\n\n## When a skill says \"publish to the issue tracker\"\n\nCreate a GitHub issue.\n\n## When a skill says \"fetch the relevant ticket\"\n\nRun `gh issue view <number> --comments`.\n\n## Wayfinding operations\n\nUsed by `/wayfinder`. The **map** is a single issue with **child** issues as tickets.\n\n- **Map**: a single issue labelled `wayfinder:map`, holding the Notes / Decisions-so-far / Fog body. `gh issue create --label wayfinder:map`.\n- **Child ticket**: an issue linked to the map as a GitHub sub-issue (`gh api` on the sub-issues endpoint). Where sub-issues aren't enabled, add the child to a task list in the map body and put `Part of #<map>` at the top of the child body. Labels: `wayfinder:<type>` (`research`/`prototype`/`grilling`/`task`). Once claimed, the ticket is assigned to the driving dev.\n- **Blocking**: GitHub's **native issue dependencies**, the canonical, UI-visible representation. Add an edge with `gh api --method POST repos/<owner>/<repo>/issues/<child>/dependencies/blocked_by -F issue_id=<blocker-db-id>`, where `<blocker-db-id>` is the blocker's numeric **database id** (`gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/issues/<n> --jq .id`, _not_ the `#number` or `node_id`). GitHub reports `issue_dependencies_summary.blocked_by` (open blockers only, the live gate). Where dependencies aren't available, fall back to a `Blocked by: #<n>, #<n>` line at the top of the child body. A ticket is unblocked when every blocker is closed.\n- **Frontier query**: list the map's open children (`gh issue list --state open`, scoped to the map's sub-issues / task list), drop any with an open blocker (`issue_dependencies_summary.blocked_by > 0`, or an open issue in the `Blocked by` line) or an assignee; first in map order wins.\n- **Claim**: `gh issue edit <n> --add-assignee @me`, the session's first write.\n- **Resolve**: `gh issue comment <n> --body \"<answer>\"`, then `gh issue close <n>`, then append a context pointer (gist + link) to the map's Decisions-so-far.\n","numLines":46,"startLine":1,"totalLines":46}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"7b46c1ea-8d04-44a7-bcee-f3bd7ca1d1cf","session_id":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

The browser\nresolves that against the *current* URL path, not the site root — e.g.\n`/admin/posts/20/edit` requests `/admin/posts/20/style.css`, and\n`/admin/accounts` requests `/admin/style.css`. The live app never mounts a\nroute at any of those paths, so every admin screen's stylesheet 404s and\nthe page falls back to raw browser-default styling.\n\nConfirmed by screenshotting `/login`, `/admin/dashboard`, `/admin/content`,\n`/admin/posts/{id}/edit`, and `/admin/accounts` — all render as bare,\nunstyled HTML (checked server logs: `GET /admin/style.css 404`,\n`GET /admin/posts/20/style.css 404`, etc., on every admin page).\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] The admin console's stylesheet loads successfully (200) from every\n      admin route, including nested ones like `/admin/posts/{id}/edit`,\n      without any `href=\"/...\"` root-absolute path anywhere in the\n      template (`scripts/check_submission.py`'s \"no root-absolute paths in\n      HTML\" check must keep passing).\n- [ ] The admin console has a clean, consistent look in the same visual\n      language as the public site (Kenyon purple + gold, Fraunces/Inter): a\n      persistent sidebar nav, styled tables and forms, clear field labels,\n      a visible success/error message after a save, and styled buttons —\n      including a styled confirmation for the destructive \"delete\" action.\n- [ ] Every admin screen works at 390px wide with no horizontal scroll (the\n      sidebar collapses or stacks at that width).\n- [ ] A test asserts the admin stylesheet URL {"parentUuid":"fd82d3b2-9824-4aba-96b1-7160c29d8787","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"64239083-c66a-4955-99a7-d35d1d813ada","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_016iNrcwgCjvTHR9w1qvaR7W","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Staff console shell (T07, #8): the live-preview landing screen, Dashboard,\n2\tContent list, Pending queue, and Metrics. Ambassador console shell (T08, #9):\n3\tthe \"My posts\" landing screen.\n4\t\n5\tEvery route but the landing screen is admin-only (require_admin, same gate\n6\tas Pages and Accounts) — an Ambassador gets a 403, an anonymous request is\n7\tredirected to /login. Page hierarchy and Accounts are their own existing\n8\trouters (app/routes/pages.py, app/routes/accounts.py); this module only adds\n9\tthe sidebar entries that point at them.\n10\t\n11\tThe landing screen (GET /admin) stays open to any logged-in user: Staff see\n12\tthe live preview described below; an Ambassador sees \"My posts\" — their own\n13\tPosts grouped by status, nothing else — which doubles as their entire\n14\tsidebar (plus logout), since every other console route is admin-only.\n15\t\"\"\"\n16\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n17\t\n18\tfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request\n19\tfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n20\t\n21\tfrom app import models, settings\n22\tfrom app.routes.auth import ensure_csrf_token, get_current_user, require_admin\n23\tfrom app.routes.public import page_context\n24\tfrom app.services import review_gate\n25\t\n26\ttemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n27\t\n28\trouter = APIRouter()\n29\t\n30\tSTATUS_CHOICES = [\"draft\", \"pending\", \"published\"]\n31\tTYPE_CHOICES = [(\"page\", \"Page\"), (\"post\", \"Post\")]\n32\t\n33\tSIDEBAR = [\n34\t    (\"/admin/dashboard\", \"Dashboard\"),\n35\t    (\"/admin/content\", \"Content list\"),\n36\t    (\"/admin/pending\", \"Pending queue\"),\n37\t    (\"/admin/accounts\", \"Accounts\"),\n38\t    (\"/admin/pages\", \"Page hierarchy\"),\n39\t    (\"/admin/metrics\", \"Metrics\"),\n40\t]\n41\t\n42\tEDITOR_SIDEBAR = [\n43\t    (\"/admin\", \"My posts\"),\n44\t]\n45\t\n46\t\n47\tdef _console_context(request: Request, user: models.User, sidebar=None) -> dict:\n48\t    return {\n49\t        \"user\": user,\n50\t        \"csrf_token\": ensure_csrf_token(request),\n51\t        \"sidebar\": [{\"href\": href, \"label\": label} for href, label in (sidebar or SIDEBAR)],\n52\t    }\n53\t\n54\t\n55\tdef _my_posts_response(request: Request, user: models.User):\n56\t    \"\"\"An Ambassador's own Posts, grouped by status — nothing belonging to\n57\t    anyone else. A Post is only editable/deletable while draft (same rule\n58\t    app/routes/posts.py enforces), so edit/delete links only render there;\n59\t    `review_gate.available_actions` supplies the rest (submit, for a draft).\"\"\"\n60\t    own_posts = models.list_posts_by_author(user.id)\n61\t    groups = []\n62\t    for status in STATUS_CHOICES:\n63\t        rows = []\n64\t        for post in sorted(\n65\t            (p for p in own_posts if p.status == status),\n66\t            key=lambda p: p.updated_at,\n67\t            reverse=True,\n68\t        ):\n69\t            program = models.get_page_by_id(post.program_id)\n70\t            rows.append({\n71\t                \"post\": post,\n72\t                \"program_title\": program.title if program else \"Unknown program\",\n73\t                \"edit_href\": f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\",\n74\t                \"delete_href\": f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/delete\",\n75\t                \"can_edit\": status == \"draft\",\n76\t                \"actions\": [\n77\t                    (action, review_gate.ACTION_LABELS[action], f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/{action}\")\n78\t                    for action in review_gate.available_actions(status, user.role, True)\n79\t                ],\n80\t            })\n81\t        groups.append({\"status\": status, \"rows\": rows})\n82\t\n83\t    context = _console_context(request, user, sidebar=EDITOR_SIDEBAR)\n84\t    context.update({\"title\": \"My posts\", \"groups\": groups})"}]},"uuid":"e1dfb319-bf02-437c-b9b5-9211a7653af8","timestamp":"2026-10-07T01:10:28.236Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/routes/console.py","content":"\"\"\"Staff console shell (T07, #8): the live-preview landing screen, Dashboard,\nContent list, Pending queue, and Metrics. Ambassador console shell (T08, #9):\nthe \"My posts\" landing screen.\n\nEvery route but the landing screen is admin-only (require_admin, same gate\nas Pages and Accounts) — an Ambassador gets a 403, an anonymous request is\nredirected to /login. Page hierarchy and Accounts are their own existing\nrouters (app/routes/pages.py, app/routes/accounts.py); this module only adds\nthe sidebar entries that point at them.\n\nThe landing screen (GET /admin) stays open to any logged-in user: Staff see\nthe live preview described below; an Ambassador sees \"My posts\" — their own\nPosts grouped by status, nothing else — which doubles as their entire\nsidebar (plus logout), since every other console route is admin-only.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import ensure_csrf_token, get_current_user, require_admin\nfrom app.routes.public import page_context\nfrom app.services import review_gate\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\nSTATUS_CHOICES = [\"draft\", \"pending\", \"published\"]\nTYPE_CHOICES = [(\"page\", \"Page\"), (\"post\", \"Post\")]\n\nSIDEBAR = [\n    (\"/admin/dashboard\", \"Dashboard\"),\n    (\"/admin/content\", \"Content list\"),\n    (\"/admin/pending\", \"Pending queue\"),\n    (\"/admin/accounts\", \"Accounts\"),\n    (\"/admin/pages\", \"Page hierarchy\"),\n    (\"/admin/metrics\", \"Metrics\"),\n]\n\nEDITOR_SIDEBAR = [\n    (\"/admin\", \"My posts\"),\n]\n\n\ndef _console_context(request: Request, user: models.User, sidebar=None) -> dict:\n    return {\n        \"user\": user,\n        \"csrf_token\": ensure_csrf_token(request),\n        \"sidebar\": [{\"href\": href, \"label\": label} for href, label in (sidebar or SIDEBAR)],\n    }\n\n\ndef _my_posts_response(request: Request, user: models.User):\n    \"\"\"An Ambassador's own Posts, grouped by status — nothing belonging to\n    anyone else. A Post is only editable/deletable while draft (same rule\n    app/routes/posts.py enforces), so edit/delete links only render there;\n    `review_gate.available_actions` supplies the rest (submit, for a draft).\"\"\"\n    own_posts = models.list_posts_by_author(user.id)\n    groups = []\n    for status in STATUS_CHOICES:\n        rows = []\n        for post in sorted(\n            (p for p in own_posts if p.status == status),\n            key=lambda p: p.updated_at,\n            reverse=True,\n        ):\n            program = models.get_page_by_id(post.program_id)\n            rows.append({\n                \"post\": post,\n                \"program_title\": program.title if program else \"Unknown program\",\n                \"edit_href\": f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\",\n                \"delete_href\": f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/delete\",\n                \"can_edit\": status == \"draft\",\n                \"actions\": [\n                    (action, review_gate.ACTION_LABELS[action], f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/{action}\")\n                    for action in review_gate.available_actions(status, user.role, True)\n                ],\n            })\n        groups.append({\"status\": status, \"rows\": rows})\n\n    context = _console_context(request, user, sidebar=EDITOR_SIDEBAR)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"My posts\", \"groups\": groups})","numLines":84,"startLine":1,"totalLines":198}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"fd82d3b2-9824-4aba-96b1-7160c29d8787","session_id":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

authoring: draft CRUD, Topic, a sanitized Markdown preview, and the\nADR-004 review-gate state machine (T04, #5).\n\nUnlike Pages (admin-only), Post authoring is open to any active user\n(require_user), with ownership enforced inside the route: an Ambassador\n(editor) may only touch their own Post, and only while it is draft; a Staff\nmember (admin) may touch any Post, same as Pages. The submit/publish/bounce/\nunpublish transitions delegate every allow/deny decision to\napp.services.review_gate, so this module just resolves the Post, asks the\nservice whether the action is allowed, and persists the result.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import ensure_csrf_token, require_user, verify_csrf\nfrom app.services import markdown, review_gate\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/posts\")\n\n\ndef _get_program_or_404(program_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    \"\"\"Resolve program_id, rejecting up front if it isn't a Program-level\n    Page — otherwise a user could fill out the whole new-post form before\n    hitting the same rejection as a save-time error (models.create_post\n    still checks this too, as the model layer's own guarantee).\"\"\"\n    program = models.get_page_by_id(program_id)\n    if program is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such program page\")\n    if not models.is_program_page(program):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"Not a Program-level page\")\n    return program\n\n\ndef _get_post_or_404(post_id: int) -> models.Post:\n    post = models.get_post_by_id(post_id)\n    if post is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such post\")\n    return post\n\n\ndef _authorize_post_write(user: models.User, post: models.Post) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Admin: any Post, any status. Editor: only their own, only while draft.\"\"\"\n    if user.role == \"admin\":\n        return\n    if post.author_id != user.id or post.status != \"draft\":\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Forbidden\")\n\n\ndef _apply_transition(user: models.User, post: models.Post, action: str) -> models.Post:\n    \"\"\"Ask review_gate whether `action` is allowed, then persist its answer.\n\n    review_gate.transition raises ValueError -> 403 (not allowed at all).\n    models.set_post_status raises StatusConflict -> 409 (it *was* allowed\n    against the status we read, but another request changed it first).\n    \"\"\"\n    is_author = post.author_id == user.id\n    try:\n        new_status = review_gate.transition(post.status, action, user.role, is_author)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=str(exc))\n    try:\n        return models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=post.status, to_status=new_status)\n    except models.StatusConflict as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(exc))\n\n\ndef _render_form(\n    request: Request,\n    post: models.Post | None,\n    program: models.Page,\n    error: str | None = None,\n    title: str = \"\",\n    body: str = \"\",\n    topic: str = \"general\",\n):\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/posts_form.html\",\n        {\n            \"title\": \"Edit post\" if post else \"New post\",\n            \"post\": post,\n            \"program\": program,\n            \"csrf_token\": token,\n            \"error\": error,\n            \"form_title\": title,\n            \"form_body\": body,\n            \"form_topic\": topic,\n            \"preview_html\": markdown.render(body),\n            \"topics\": models.TOPIC_CHOICES,\n        },\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef list_posts(\n    request: Request, program_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    program = _get_program_or_404(program_id)\n    posts = models.list_posts_by_program(program_id)\n    if user.role != \"admin\":\n        posts = [p for p in posts if p.author_id == user.id]\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    posts_with_actions = [\n        (\n            post,\n            [\n                (action, review_gate.ACTION_LABELS[action])\n                for action in review_gate.available_actions(\n                    post.status, user.role, post.author_id == user.id\n                )\n            ],\n        )\n        for post in posts\n    ]\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/posts_list.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Posts\", \"program\": program, \"posts_with_actions\": posts_with_actions,\n         \"csrf_token\": token},\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"/new\")\ndef new_post_form(\n    request: Request, program_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    program = _get_program_or_404(program_id)\n    return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/new\")\nasync def create_post(\n    request: Request,\n    program_id: int = Form(...),\n    title: str = Form(\"\"),\n    body: str = Form(\"\"),\n    topic: str = Form(\"general\"),\n    action: str = Form(\"save\"),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    program = _get_program_or_404(program_id)\n    if action == \"preview\":\n        return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program,\n                             title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    if not title.strip():\n        return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program,\n                             error=\"Title is required.\", title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    try:\n        models.create_post(\n            program_id=program_id, title=title, body=body, topic=topic, author_id=user.id,\n        )\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program,\n                             error=str(exc), title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    return RedirectResponse(url=f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{post_id}/edit\")\ndef edit_post_form(\n    request: Request, post_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _authorize_post_write(user, post)\n    program = _get_program_or_404(post.program_id)\n    return _render_form(request, post=post, program=program,\n                         title=post.title, body=post.body, topic=post.topic)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/edit\")\nasync def update_post(\n    request: Request,\n    post_id: int,\n    title: str = Form(\"\"),\n    body: str = Form(\"\"),\n    topic: str = Form(\"general\"),\n    action: str = Form(\"save\"),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _authorize_post_write(user, post)\n    program = _get_program_or_404(post.program_id)\n    if action == \"preview\":\n        return _render_form(request, post=post, program=program,\n                             title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    if not title.strip():\n        return _render_form(request, post=post, program=program,\n                             error=\"Title is required.\", title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    try:\n        models.update_post(post_id, title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        return _render_form(request, post=post, program=program,\n                             error=str(exc), title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    return RedirectResponse(url=f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program.id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{post_id}/delete\")\ndef confirm_delete_post(\n    request: Request, post_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _authorize_post_write(user, post)\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/posts_delete.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Delete post?\", \"post\": post, \"csrf_token\": token},\n    )\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/delete\")\nasync def delete_post(\n    post_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _authorize_post_write(user, post)\n    program_id = post.program_id\n    models.delete_post(post_id)\n    return RedirectResponse(url=f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/submit\")\nasync def submit_post(\n    post_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _apply_transition(user, post, \"submit\")\n    return RedirectResponse(url=f\"/admin/posts?program_id={post.program_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/publish\")\nasync def publish_post(\n    post_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _apply_transition(user, post, \"publish\")\n    return RedirectResponse(url=f\"/admin/posts?program_id={post.program_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/bounce\")\nasync def bounce_post(\n    post_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _apply_transition(user, post, \"bounce\")\n    return RedirectResponse(url=f\"/admin/posts?program_id={post.program_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/unpublish\")\nasync def unpublish_post(\n    post_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _apply_transition(user, post, \"unpublish\")\n    return RedirectResponse(url=f\"/admin/posts?program_id={post.program_id}\", \"DATABASE_PATH\", tmp_path / \"test.db\")\n\n    from app import db, models\n\n    db.init_db()\n    models.create_user(email=DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"][\"email\"],\n                        password=DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"][\"password\"],\n                        role=\"admin\", display_name=DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"][\"display_name\"])\n display_name=DEMO_USERS[\"editor\"][\"display_name\"])\n    models.create_user(email=DEACTIVATED_USER[\"email\"],\n                        password=DEACTIVATED_USER[\"password\"],\n client_as(seeded_db):\n    \"\"\"Return a factory: client_as(\"editor\") -> a logged-in TestClient.\"\"\"\n\n    def _login(role: str) -> TestClient:\n        user = DEMO_USERS[role]\n        c = First, the new shared console-shell module with the CSS, sidebar, context helper, and flash-redirect helper."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":6283,"cache_read_input_tokens":353980,"output_tokens":3853,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":134},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":6283,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":3853,"cache_read_input_tokens":353980,"cache_creation_input_tokens":6283,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":6283},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"apiBlockIndex":1,"requestId":"req_011CfmzagmWnHgcGjPUiG23P","type":"assistant","uuid":"0856df03-8ad4-4666-b32e-94341084c4d4","timestamp":"2026-10-07T01:16:41.762Z","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":null,"session_id":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}
{"parentUuid":"0856df03-8ad4-4666-b32e-94341084c4d4","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011Cfmzah48MyDGZWJ9nsLAC","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01W6Lqr4UeZcBwf5fWK6bg5B","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/services/console_shell.py","content":"\"\"\"Shared chrome for every server-rendered admin screen: the sidebar nav,\nthe relative stylesheet link, and post-save flash messages. Every\n`app/routes/*.py` module except `public.py` uses this (the public site has\nits own, unrelated live-preview chrome in `app/routes/public.py`).\n\nThe live admin server has no static-file route tied to a page's own nesting\ndepth — `/admin/posts/{id}/edit` and `/login` sit at different depths — so\n`css_path_for` computes the right number of \"../\" to reach the one\n`GET /style.css` route (registered in app/routes/console.py) from wherever\nthe request currently is. Same idea as app.publish's `_relative_link` for\nthe static export, just computed per-request instead of precomputed per\nchain. Issue #13: a literal `href=\"/...\"` here would still work on this live\nserver, but `scripts/check_submission.py` greps every tracked template for\nroot-absolute paths regardless of whether the page is ever statically\nexported, so this stays relative like everything else.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom urllib.parse import quote\n\nfrom fastapi import Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import models\nfrom app.routes.auth import ensure_csrf_token\n\nSIDEBAR = [\n    (\"/admin/dashboard\", \"Dashboard\"),\n    (\"/admin/content\", \"Content list\"),\n    (\"/admin/pending\", \"Pending queue\"),\n    (\"/admin/accounts\", \"Accounts\"),\n    (\"/admin/pages\", \"Page hierarchy\"),\n    (\"/admin/metrics\", \"Metrics\"),\n]\n\nEDITOR_SIDEBAR = [\n    (\"/admin\", \"My posts\"),\n]\n\n\ndef css_path_for(request: Request) -> str:\n    depth = len([s for s in request.url.path.strip(\"/\").split(\"/\") if s]) - 1\n    return \"../\" * max(depth, 0) + \"style.css\"\n\n\ndef console_context(request: Request, user: models.User, sidebar=None) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"The csrf token, stylesheet path, and sidebar every authenticated\n    admin screen needs. Defaults the sidebar by role (Staff vs Ambassador)\n    so most call sites don't have to pick one themselves.\"\"\"\n    chosen = sidebar or (SIDEBAR if user.role == \"admin\" else EDITOR_SIDEBAR)\n    return {\n        \"user\": user,\n        \"csrf_token\": ensure_csrf_token(request),\n        \"css_path\": css_path_for(request),\n        \"sidebar\": [{\"href\": href, \"label\": label} for href, label in chosen],\n    }\n\n\ndef redirect_with_flash(url: str, message: str) -> RedirectResponse:\n    \"\"\"A 303 redirect carrying a one-time success message, read back by\n    templates/base.html's `request.query_params`. No session state: a\n    refresh of the destination page just drops the message, which is fine\n    for a \"your save worked\" banner.\"\"\"\n    sep = \"&\" if \"?\" in url else \"?\"\n    return RedirectResponse(url=f\"{url}{sep}flash={quote(message)}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n# Reuses the public site's Kenyon purple + gold palette and Fraunces/Inter\n# fonts (app/publish.py's CSS) for a consistent look, but is otherwise\n# self-contained: the admin console's HTML (sidebar, forms, plain <ul> lists\n# standing in for tables) is different enough from the public site's that\n# sharing one stylesheet would mean every admin rule risks colliding with a\n# public one, or vice versa.\nADMIN_CSS = \"\"\"/* Admin console shell — issue #13. Same palette/fonts as the\n   public site (app/publish.py's CSS), different components: a sidebar\n   layout, plain lists standing in for tables, and HTML forms. */\n:root {\n  color-scheme: light dark;\n  --purple: #5B2A86;\n  --purple-dark: #3E1C5E;\n  --purple-light: #F2EBFA;\n  --gold: #C98A3B;\n  --gold-dark: #9C6723;\n  --ink: #1F1626;\n  --muted: #5a5064;\n  --border: #E4DCEC;\n  --paper: #FDFBFE;\n  --panel: #FFFFFF;\n  --danger: #B3261E;\n  --danger-dark: #8C1D16;\n  --danger-bg: #FBE9E4;\n  --success-bg: #E3F3EF;\n  --success-border: #2E7D6B;\n}\n* { box-sizing: border-box; }\nhtml { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; }\nbody {\n  font: 16px/1.6 \"Inter\", system-ui, sans-serif;\n  margin: 0;\n  color: var(--ink);\n  background: var(--paper);\n  overflow-wrap: anywhere;\n}\nh1, h2 { font-family: \"Fraunces\", Georgia, serif; line-height: 1.2; margin: 0 0 1rem; }\nh2 { font-size: 1.25rem; margin-top: 2rem; }\na { color: var(--purple-dark); }\n:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--gold); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 2px; }\n\nheader.site-header {\n  background: var(--purple);\n  padding: 0.85rem 1.5rem;\n}\nheader.site-header .brand {\n  color: #fff;\n  font-family: \"Fraunces\", Georgia, serif;\n  font-weight: 600;\n  font-size: 1.1rem;\n}\nmain { padding: 1.5rem; max-width: 68rem; margin: 0 auto; }\nfooter { padding: 1rem 1.5rem; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.85rem; }\n\n.flash {\n  background: var(--success-bg);\n  border: 1px solid var(--success-border);\n  color: #1c4038;\n  padding: 0.7rem 1rem;\n  border-radius: 0.5rem;\n  margin: 0 0 1.25rem;\n  font-weight: 600;\n}\n[role=\"alert\"] {\n  background: var(--danger-bg);\n  border: 1px solid var(--danger);\n  color: var(--danger-dark);\n  padding: 0.7rem 1rem;\n  border-radius: 0.5rem;\n  margin: 0 0 1.25rem;\n  font-weight: 600;\n}\n\n/* -- forms ------------------------------------------------------------- */\nform { margin: 0 0 1.25rem; }\nlabel { display: block; margin: 0 0 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--muted); }\ninput[type=\"text\"], input[type=\"email\"], input[type=\"password\"], select, textarea {\n  display: block;\n  margin-top: 0.3rem;\n  width: 100%;\n  max-width: 32rem;\n  font: inherit;\n  padding: 0.5rem 0.7rem;\n  border: 1px solid var(--border);\n  border-radius: 0.4rem;\n  background: #fff;\n  color: var(--ink);\n}\ninput[type=\"checkbox\"] { width: auto; display: inline-block; margin-right: 0.4rem; }\ntextarea { min-height: 9rem; font-family: ui-monospace, \"SFMono-Regular\", monospace; font-size: 0.9rem; }\ninput:focus, select:focus, textarea:focus { border-color: var(--purple); }\n\nbutton, .btn {\n  font: inherit;\n  font-weight: 600;\n  font-size: 0.95rem;\n  border: none;\n  border-radius: 999px;\n  padding: 0.5rem 1.2rem;\n  background: var(--purple);\n  color: #fff;\n  cursor: pointer;\n  text-decoration: none;\n  display: inline-block;\n}\nbutton:hover, .btn:hover { background: var(--purple-dark); }\nbutton.btn-danger { background: var(--danger); }\nbutton.btn-danger:hover { background: var(--danger-dark); }\n\n.post-preview, .preview-pane {\n  border: 1px solid var(--border);\n  border-radius: 0.6rem;\n  padding: 1rem 1.25rem;\n  background: #fff;\n  max-width: 40rem;\n}\n\n/* -- lists standing in for tables --------------------------------------- */\nul { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }\nmain ul li {\n  display: flex;\n  flex-wrap: wrap;\n  align-items: center;\n  gap: 0.6rem;\n  padding: 0.7rem 0.9rem;\n  border: 1px solid var(--border);\n  border-radius: 0.5rem;\n  margin: 0 0 0.6rem;\n  background: #fff;\n}\nmain ul li form { margin: 0; }\n\n/* The Page hierarchy tree nests arbitrarily deep — indent it instead of\n   boxing every level like a flat row list. */\n.page-tree, .page-tree ul { padding-left: 0; }\n.page-tree li, .page-tree li li {\n  display: block;\n  border: none;\n  background: none;\n  padding: 0.3rem 0 0.3rem 0.9rem;\n  margin: 0;\n  border-left: 2px solid var(--border);\n}\n\n/* -- the Staff/Ambassador console shell --------------------------------- */\n.console { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0; }\n.console-sidebar {\n  flex: 0 0 15rem;\n  background: var(--purple-light);\n  border-radius: 0.6rem;\n  padding: 1.1rem;\n  margin-right: 1.75rem;\n}\n.console-sidebar p { margin: 0 0 0.6rem; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--muted); }\n.console-sidebar nav ul { margin-top: 0.75rem; }\n.console-sidebar nav li {\n  display: block; border: none; background: none; padding: 0; margin: 0 0 0.25rem;\n}\n.console-sidebar nav a {\n  display: block;\n  padding: 0.45rem 0.6rem;\n  border-radius: 0.4rem;\n  color: var(--purple-dark);\n  font-weight: 600;\n  text-decoration: none;\n}\n.console-sidebar nav a:hover { background: #fff; }\n.console-main { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }\n\n@media (max-width: 30rem) {\n  main { padding: 1rem; }\n  .console { flex-direction: column; }\n  .console-sidebar { flex: none; width: 100%; margin: 0 0 1.25rem; }\n  input[type=\"text\"], input[type=\"email\"], input[type=\"password\"], select, textarea,\n  .post-preview, .preview-pane { max-width: none; }\n}\n\"\"\"\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":6283,"cache_read_input_tokens":353980,"output_tokens":3853,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":134},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":6283,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":3853,"cache_read_input_tokens":353980,"cache_creation_input_tokens":6283,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":6283},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01W6Lqr4UeZcBwf5fWK6bg5B":{"file_path":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/services/console_shell.py","content":"\"\"\"Shared chrome for every server-rendered admin screen: the sidebar nav,\nthe relative stylesheet link, and post-save flash messages. Every\n`app/routes/*.py` module except `public.py` uses this (the public site has\nits own, unrelated live-preview chrome in `app/routes/public.py`).\n\nThe live admin server has no static-file route tied to a page's own nesting\ndepth — `/admin/posts/{id}/edit` and `/login` sit at different depths — so\n`css_path_for` computes the right number of \"../\" to reach the one\n`GET /style.css` route (registered in app/routes/console.py) from wherever\nthe request currently is. Same idea as app.publish's `_relative_link` for\nthe static export, just computed per-request instead of precomputed per\nchain. Issue #13: a literal `href=\"/...\"` here would still work on this live\nserver, but `scripts/check_submission.py` greps every tracked template for\nroot-absolute paths regardless of whether the page is ever statically\nexported, so this stays relative like everything else.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom urllib.parse import quote\n\nfrom fastapi import Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import models\nfrom app.routes.auth import ensure_csrf_token\n\nSIDEBAR = [\n    (\"/admin/dashboard\", \"Dashboard\"),\n    (\"/admin/content\", \"Content list\"),\n    (\"/admin/pending\", \"Pending queue\"),\n    (\"/admin/accounts\", \"Accounts\"),\n    (\"/admin/pages\", \"Page hierarchy\"),\n    (\"/admin/metrics\", \"Metrics\"),\n]\n\nEDITOR_SIDEBAR = [\n    (\"/admin\", \"My posts\"),\n]\n\n\ndef css_path_for(request: Request) -> str:\n    depth = len([s for s in request.url.path.strip(\"/\").split(\"/\") if s]) - 1\n    return \"../\" * max(depth, 0) + \"style.css\"\n\n\ndef console_context(request: Request, user: models.User, sidebar=None) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"The csrf token, stylesheet path, and sidebar every authenticated\n    admin screen needs. Defaults the sidebar by role (Staff vs Ambassador)\n    so most call sites don't have to pick one themselves.\"\"\"\n    chosen = sidebar or (SIDEBAR if user.role == \"admin\" else EDITOR_SIDEBAR)\n    return {\n        \"user\": user,\n        \"csrf_token\": ensure_csrf_token(request),\n        \"css_path\": css_path_for(request),\n        \"sidebar\": [{\"href\": href, \"label\": label} for href, label in chosen],\n    }\n\n\ndef redirect_with_flash(url: str, message: str) -> RedirectResponse:\n    \"\"\"A 303 redirect carrying a one-time success message, read back by\n    templates/base.html's `request.query_params`. Page hierarchy and Accounts are their own existing\nrouters (app/routes/pages.py, app/routes/accounts.py); this module only adds\nthe sidebar entries that point at them.\n\nThe landing screen (GET /admin) stays open to any logged-in user: Staff see\nthe live preview described below; an Ambassador sees \"My posts\" — their own\nPosts grouped by status, nothing else — which doubles as their entire\nsidebar (plus logout), since every other console route is admin-only.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import ensure_csrf_token, get_current_user, require_admin\nfrom app.routes.public import page_context\nfrom app.services import review_gate\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\nSTATUS_CHOICES = [\"draft\", \"pending\", \"published\"]\nTYPE_CHOICES = [(\"page\", \"Page\"), (\"post\", \"Post\")]\n\nSIDEBAR = [\n    (\"/admin/dashboard\", \"Dashboard\"),\n    (\"/admin/content\", \"Content list\"),\n    (\"/admin/pending\", \"Pending queue\"),\n    (\"/admin/accounts\", \"Accounts\"),\n    (\"/admin/pages\", \"Page hierarchy\"),\n    (\"/admin/metrics\", \"Metrics\"),\n]\n\nEDITOR_SIDEBAR = [\n    (\"/admin\", \"My posts\"),\n]\n\n\ndef _console_context(request: Request, user: models.User, sidebar=None) -> dict:\n    return {\n        \"user\": user,\n        \"csrf_token\": ensure_csrf_token(request),\n        \"sidebar\": [{\"href\": href, \"label\": label} for href, label in (sidebar or SIDEBAR)],\n    }\n\n\ndef _my_posts_response(request: Request, user: models.User):\n    \"\"\"An Ambassador's own Posts, grouped by status — nothing belonging to\n    anyone else. A Post is only editable/deletable while draft (same rule\n    app/routes/posts.py enforces), so edit/delete links only render there;\n    `review_gate.available_actions` supplies the rest (submit, for a draft).\"\"\"\n    own_posts = models.list_posts_by_author(user.id)\n    groups = []\n    for status in STATUS_CHOICES:\n        rows = []\n        for post in sorted(\n            (p for p in own_posts if p.status == status),\n            key=lambda p: p.updated_at,\n            reverse=True,\n        ):\n            program = models.get_page_by_id(post.program_id)\n            rows.append({\n                \"post\": post,\n                \"program_title\": program.title if program else \"Unknown program\",\n                \"edit_href\": f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\",\n                \"delete_href\": f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/delete\",\n                \"can_edit\": status == \"draft\",\n                \"actions\": [\n                    (action, review_gate.ACTION_LABELS[action], f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/{action}\")\n                    for action in review_gate.available_actions(status, user.role, True)\n                ],\n            })\n        groups.append({\"status\": status, \"rows\": rows})\n\n    context = _console_context(request, user, sidebar=EDITOR_SIDEBAR)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"My posts\", \"groups\": groups})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/my_posts.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin\")\ndef admin_home(request: Request, user: models.User | None = Depends(get_current_user)):\n    if user is None:\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/hello.html\",\n            {\"title\": \"Admin\", \"user\": None, \"csrf_token\": None},\n        )\n    if user.role != \"admin\":\n        return _my_posts_response(request, user)\n\n    home_page = models.ensure_home_page()\n    context = _console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"Admin — Live preview\", \"preview\": page_context(home_page)})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/home.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/dashboard\")\ndef dashboard(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    posts = models.list_all_posts()\n    status_counts = {status: 0 for status in STATUS_CHOICES}\n    for post in posts:\n        status_counts[post.status] += 1\n\n    level_counts: dict[int, int] = {}\n    for page in models.list_all_pages():\n        level = len(models.list_ancestors(page))\n        level_counts[level] = level_counts.get(level, 0) + 1\n\n    context = _console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\n        \"title\": \"Dashboard\",\n        \"status_counts\": [(status, status_counts[status]) for status in STATUS_CHOICES],\n        \"level_counts\": sorted(level_counts.items()),\n        \"active_accounts\": sum(1 for u in models.list_users() if u.active),\n    })\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/dashboard.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/content\")\ndef content_list(\n    request: Request,\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    status: str = \"\",\n    kind: str = \"\",\n):\n    items = []\n    if kind in (\"\", \"page\"):\n        for page in models.list_all_pages():\n            if status and page.status != status:\n                continue\n            items.append({\n                \"kind\": \"Page\", \"title\": page.title, \"status\": page.status,\n                \"href\": f\"/admin/pages/{page.id}/edit\",\n            })\n    if kind in (\"\", \"post\"):\n        for post in models.list_all_posts():\n            if status and post.status != status:\n                continue\n            items.append({\n                \"kind\": \"Post\", \"title\": post.title, \"status\": post.status,\n                \"href\": f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\",\n            })\n\n    context = _console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\n        \"title\": \"Content list\",\n        \"items\": items,\n        \"status_choices\": STATUS_CHOICES,\n        \"type_choices\": TYPE_CHOICES,\n        \"status_filter\": status,\n        \"kind_filter\": kind,\n    })\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/content_list.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/pending\")\ndef pending_queue(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    pending = sorted(\n        (p for p in models.list_all_posts() if p.status == \"pending\"),\n        key=lambda p: p.updated_at,\n    )\n    rows = []\n    for post in pending:\n        author = models.get_user_by_id(post.author_id) if post.author_id else None\n        rows.append({\n            \"post\": post,\n            \"author_name\": author.display_name if author else \"Unknown\",\n            \"submitted_date\": (post.updated_at or \"\")[:10],\n            \"edit_href\": f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\",\n        })\n\n    context = _console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"Pending queue\", \"rows\": rows})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/pending_queue.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/metrics\")\ndef metrics(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    programs = [p for p in models.list_all_pages() if models.is_program_page(p)]\n    rows = sorted(\n        (\n            {\"program\": program, \"count\": len(models.list_posts_by_program(program.id))}\n            for program in programs\n        ),\n        key=lambda row: row[\"program\"].title,\n    )\n\n    context = _console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"Metrics\", \"rows\": rows})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/metrics.html\", context)\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":16,"oldLines":12,"newStart":16,"newLines":13,"lines":[" from __future__ import annotations"," "," from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request","+from context.update({\"title\": \"Admin — Live preview\", \"preview\": page_context(home_page)})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/home.html\", context)","originalFile":"\"\"\"Staff console shell (T07, #8): the live-preview landing screen, Dashboard,\nContent list, Pending queue, and Metrics. Ambassador console shell (T08, #9):\nthe \"My posts\" landing screen.\n\nEvery route but the landing screen is admin-only (require_admin, same gate\nas Pages and Accounts) — an Ambassador gets a 403, an anonymous request is\nredirected to /login. Page hierarchy and Accounts are their own existing\nrouters (app/routes/pages.py, app/routes/accounts.py); this module only adds\nthe sidebar entries that point at them.\n\nThe landing screen (GET /admin) stays open to any logged-in user: Staff see\nthe live preview described below; an Ambassador sees \"My posts\" — their own\nPosts grouped by status, nothing else — which doubles as their entire\nsidebar (plus logout), since every other console route is admin-only.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import get_current_user, require_admin\nfrom app.routes.public import page_context\nfrom app.services import console_shell, review_gate\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\nSTATUS_CHOICES = [\"draft\", \"pending\", \"published\"]\nTYPE_CHOICES = [(\"page\", \"Page\"), (\"post\", \"Post\")]\n\n\n@router.get(\"/style.css\")\ndef admin_stylesheet() -> PlainTextResponse:\n    \"\"\"The admin console's stylesheet (issue #13) — every admin template\n    links here with a relative, depth-computed href (console_shell.css_path_for),\n    since a literal root-absolute href would fail check_submission.py's scan\n    of every tracked template, live-server-only or not.\"\"\"\n    return PlainTextResponse(console_shell.ADMIN_CSS, media_type=\"text/css\")\n\n\ndef _my_posts_response(request: Request, user: models.User):\n    \"\"\"An Ambassador's own Posts, grouped by status — nothing belonging to\n    anyone else. A Post is only editable/deletable while draft (same rule\n    app/routes/posts.py enforces), so edit/delete links only render there;\n    `review_gate.available_actions` supplies the rest (submit, for a draft).\"\"\"\n    own_posts = models.list_posts_by_author(user.id)\n    groups = []\n    for status in STATUS_CHOICES:\n        rows = []\n        for post in sorted(\n            (p for p in own_posts if p.status == status),\n            key=lambda p: p.updated_at,\n            reverse=True,\n        ):\n            program = models.get_page_by_id(post.program_id)\n            rows.append({\n                \"post\": post,\n                \"program_title\": program.title if program else \"Unknown program\",\n                \"edit_href\": f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\",\n                \"delete_href\": f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/delete\",\n                \"can_edit\": status == \"draft\",\n                \"actions\": [\n                    (action, review_gate.ACTION_LABELS[action], f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/{action}\")\n                    for action in review_gate.available_actions(status, user.role, True)\n                ],\n            })\n        groups.append({\"status\": status, \"rows\": rows})\n\n    context = _console_context(request, user, sidebar=EDITOR_SIDEBAR)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"My posts\", \"groups\": groups})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/my_posts.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin\")\ndef admin_home(request: Request, user: models.User | None = Depends(get_current_user)):\n    if user is None:\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/hello.html\",\n            {\"title\": \"Admin\", \"user\": None, \"csrf_token\": None},\n        )\n    if user.role != \"admin\":\n        return _my_posts_response(request, user)\n\n    home_page = models.ensure_home_page()\n    context = _console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"Admin — Live preview\", \"preview\": page_context(home_page)})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/home.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/dashboard\")\ndef dashboard(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    posts = models.list_all_posts()\n    status_counts = {status: 0 for status in STATUS_CHOICES}\n    for post in posts:\n        status_counts[post.status] += 1\n\n    level_counts: dict[int, int] = {}\n    for page in models.list_all_pages():\n        level = len(models.list_ancestors(page))\n        level_counts[level] = level_counts.get(level, 0) + 1\n\n    context = _console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\n        \"title\": \"Dashboard\",\n        \"status_counts\": [(status, status_counts[status]) for status in STATUS_CHOICES],\n        \"level_counts\": sorted(level_counts.items()),\n        \"active_accounts\": sum(1 for u in models.list_users() if u.active),\n    })\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/dashboard.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/content\")\ndef content_list(\n    request: Request,\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    status: str = \"\",\n    kind: str = \"\",\n):\n    items = []\n    if kind in (\"\", \"page\"):\n        for page in models.list_all_pages():\n            if status and page.status != status:\n                continue\n            items.append({\n                \"kind\": \"Page\", \"title\": page.title, \"status\": page.status,\n                \"href\": f\"/admin/pages/{page.id}/edit\",\n            })\n    if kind in (\"\", \"post\"):\n        for post in models.list_all_posts():\n            if status and post.status != status:\n                continue\n            items.append({\n                \"kind\": \"Post\", \"title\": post.title, \"status\": post.status,\n                \"href\": f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\",\n            })\n\n    context = _console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\n        \"title\": \"Content list\",\n        \"items\": items,\n        \"status_choices\": STATUS_CHOICES,\n        \"type_choices\": TYPE_CHOICES,\n        \"status_filter\": status,\n        \"kind_filter\": kind,\n    })\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/content_list.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/pending\")\ndef pending_queue(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    pending = sorted(\n        (p for p in models.list_all_posts() if p.status == \"pending\"),\n        key=lambda p: p.updated_at,\n    )\n    rows = []\n    for post in pending:\n        author = models.get_user_by_id(post.author_id) if post.author_id else None\n        rows.append({\n            \"post\": post,\n            \"author_name\": author.display_name if author else \"Unknown\",\n            \"submitted_date\": (post.updated_at or \"\")[:10],\n            \"edit_href\": f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\",\n        })\n\n    context = _console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"Pending queue\", \"rows\": rows})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/pending_queue.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/metrics\")\ndef metrics(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    programs = [p for p in models.list_all_pages() if models.is_program_page(p)]\n    rows = sorted(\n        (\n            {\"program\": program, \"count\": len(models.list_posts_by_program(program.id))}\n            for program in programs\n        ),\n        key=lambda row: row[\"program\"].title,\n    )\n\n    context = _console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"Metrics\", \"rows\": rows})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/metrics.html\", context)\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":69,"oldLines":7,"newStart":69,"newLines":7,"lines":["             })","         groups.append({\"status\": status, \"rows\": rows})"," ","-    context = Page hierarchy and Accounts are their own existing\n8\trouters (app/routes/pages.py, app/routes/accounts.py); this module only adds\n9\tthe sidebar entries that point at them.\n10\t\n11\tThe landing screen (GET /admin) stays open to any logged-in user: Staff see\n12\tthe live preview described below; an Ambassador sees \"My posts\" — their own\n13\tPosts grouped by status, nothing else — which doubles as their entire\n14\tsidebar (plus logout), since every other console route is admin-only.\n15\t\"\"\"\n16\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n17\t\n18\tfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request\n19\tfrom fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse\n20\tfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n21\t\n22\tfrom app import models, settings\n23\tfrom app.routes.auth import get_current_user, require_admin\n24\tfrom app.routes.public import page_context\n25\tfrom app.services import console_shell, review_gate\n26\t\n27\ttemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n28\t\n29\trouter = APIRouter()\n30\t\n31\tSTATUS_CHOICES = [\"draft\", \"pending\", \"published\"]\n32\tTYPE_CHOICES = [(\"page\", \"Page\"), (\"post\", \"Post\")]\n33\t\n34\t\n35\t@router.get(\"/style.css\")\n36\tdef admin_stylesheet() -> PlainTextResponse:\n37\t    \"\"\"The admin console's stylesheet (issue #13) — every admin template\n38\t    links here with a relative, depth-computed href (console_shell.css_path_for),\n39\t    since a literal root-absolute href would fail check_submission.py's scan\n40\t    of every tracked template, live-server-only or not.\"\"\"\n41\t    return PlainTextResponse(console_shell.ADMIN_CSS, media_type=\"text/css\")\n42\t\n43\t\n44\tdef _my_posts_response(request: Request, user: models.User):\n45\t    \"\"\"An Ambassador's own Posts, grouped by status — nothing belonging to\n46\t    anyone else. A Post is only editable/deletable while draft (same rule\n47\t    app/routes/posts.py enforces), so edit/delete links only render there;\n48\t    `review_gate.available_actions` supplies the rest (submit, for a draft).\"\"\"\n49\t    own_posts = models.list_posts_by_author(user.id)\n50\t    groups = []\n51\t    for status in STATUS_CHOICES:\n52\t        rows = []\n53\t        for post in sorted(\n54\t            (p for p in own_posts if p.status == status),\n55\t            key=lambda p: p.updated_at,\n56\t            reverse=True,\n57\t        ):\n58\t            program = models.get_page_by_id(post.program_id)\n59\t            rows.append({\n60\t                \"post\": post,\n61\t                \"program_title\": program.title if program else \"Unknown program\",\n62\t                \"edit_href\": f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\",\n63\t                \"delete_href\": f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/delete\",\n64\t                \"can_edit\": status == \"draft\",\n65\t                \"actions\": [\n66\t                    (action, review_gate.ACTION_LABELS[action], f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/{action}\")\n67\t                    for action in review_gate.available_actions(status, user.role, True)\n68\t                ],\n69\t            })\n70\t        groups.append({\"status\": status, \"rows\": rows})\n71\t\n72\t    context = console_shell.console_context(request, user, sidebar=console_shell.EDITOR_SIDEBAR)\n73\t    context.update({\"title\": \"My posts\", \"groups\": groups})\n74\t    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/my_posts.html\", context)\n75\t\n76\t\n77\t@router.get(\"/admin\")\n78\tdef admin_home(request: Request, user: models.User | None = Depends(get_current_user)):\n79\t    if user is None:\n80\t        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n81\t            request, \"admin/hello.html\",\n82\t            {\"title\": \"Admin\", \"user\": page_context(home_page)})\n91\t    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/home.html\", context)\n92\t\n93\t\n94\t@router.get(\"/admin/dashboard\")\n95\tdef dashboard(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n96\t    posts = models.list_all_posts()\n97\t    status_counts = {status: 0 for status in STATUS_CHOICES}\n98\t    for post in posts:\n99\t        status_counts[post.status] += 1\n100\t\n101\t    level_counts: dict[int, int] = {}\n102\t    for page in models.list_all_pages():\n103\t        level = len(models.list_ancestors(page))\n104\t        level_counts[level] = level_counts.get(level, 0) + 1\n105\t\n106\t    context = console_shell.console_context(request, user)\n107\t    context.update({\n108\t        \"title\": \"Dashboard\",\n109\t
