Every\n`app/routes/*.py` module except `public.py` uses this (the public site has\nits own, unrelated live-preview chrome in `app/routes/public.py`).\n\nIssue #13: the admin console's stylesheet link is relative and\ndepth-computed (see app.services.css_path) rather than root-absolute —\na literal `href=\"/...\"` would still work on this live server, but\n`scripts/check_submission.py` greps every tracked template for\nroot-absolute paths regardless of whether the page is ever statically\nexported, so this stays relative like everything else.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom urllib.parse import quote\n\nfrom fastapi import Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import models\nfrom app.routes.auth import ensure_csrf_token\nfrom app.services.css_path import css_path_for\n\nSIDEBAR = [","originalFile":"\"\"\"Shared chrome for every server-rendered admin screen: the sidebar nav,\nthe relative stylesheet link, and post-save flash messages. Every\n`app/routes/*.py` module except `public.py` uses this (the public site has\nits own, unrelated live-preview chrome in `app/routes/public.py`).\n\nThe live admin server has no static-file route tied to a page's own nesting\ndepth — `/admin/posts/{id}/edit` and `/login` sit at different depths — so\n`css_path_for` computes the right number of \"../\" to reach the one\n`GET /style.css` route (registered in app/routes/console.py) from wherever\nthe request currently is. Same idea as app.publish's `_relative_link` for\nthe static export, just computed per-request instead of precomputed per\nchain. Issue #13: a literal `href=\"/...\"` here would still work on this live\nserver, but `scripts/check_submission.py` greps every tracked template for\nroot-absolute paths regardless of whether the page is ever statically\nexported, so this stays relative like everything else.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom urllib.parse import quote\n\nfrom fastapi import Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import models\nfrom app.routes.auth import ensure_csrf_token\n\nSIDEBAR = [\n    (\"/admin/dashboard\", \"Dashboard\"),\n    (\"/admin/content\", \"Content list\"),\n    (\"/admin/pending\", \"Pending queue\"),\n    (\"/admin/accounts\", \"Accounts\"),\n    (\"/admin/pages\", \"Page hierarchy\"),\n    (\"/admin/metrics\", \"Metrics\"),\n]\n\nEDITOR_SIDEBAR = [\n    (\"/admin\", \"My posts\"),\n]\n\n\ndef css_path_for(request: Request) -> str:\n    depth = len([s for s in request.url.path.strip(\"/\").split(\"/\") if s]) - 1\n    return \"../\" * max(depth, 0) + \"style.css\"\n\n\ndef console_context(request: Request, user: models.User, sidebar=None) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"The csrf token, stylesheet path, and sidebar every authenticated\n    admin screen needs. Defaults the sidebar by role (Staff vs Ambassador)\n    so most call sites don't have to pick one themselves.\"\"\"\n    chosen = sidebar or (SIDEBAR if user.role == \"admin\" else EDITOR_SIDEBAR)\n    return {\n        \"user\": user,\n        \"csrf_token\": ensure_csrf_token(request),\n        \"css_path\": css_path_for(request),\n        \"sidebar\": [{\"href\": href, \"label\": label} for href, label in chosen],\n    }\n\n\ndef redirect_with_flash(url: str, message: str) -> RedirectResponse:\n    \"\"\"A 303 redirect carrying a one-time success message, read back by\n    templates/base.html's `request.query_params`. No session state: a\n    refresh of the destination page just drops the message, which is fine\n    for a \"your save worked\" banner.\"\"\"\n    sep = \"&\" if \"?\" in url else \"?\"\n    return RedirectResponse(url=f\"{url}{sep}flash={quote(message)}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n# Reuses the public site's Kenyon purple + gold palette and Fraunces/Inter\n# fonts (app/publish.py's CSS) for a consistent look, but is otherwise\n# self-contained: the admin console's HTML (sidebar, forms, plain <ul> lists\n# standing in for tables) is different enough from the public site's that\n# sharing one stylesheet would mean every admin rule risks colliding with a\n# public one, or vice versa.\nADMIN_CSS = \"\"\"/* Admin console shell — issue #13. Same palette/fonts as the\n   public site (app/publish.py's CSS), different components: a sidebar\n   layout, plain lists standing in for tables, and HTML forms. */\n:root {\n  color-scheme: light dark;\n  --purple: #5B2A86;\n  --purple-dark: #3E1C5E;\n  --purple-light: #F2EBFA;\n  --gold: #C98A3B;\n  --gold-dark: #9C6723;\n  --ink: #1F1626;\n  --muted: #5a5064;\n  --border: #E4DCEC;\n  --paper: #FDFBFE;\n  --panel: #FFFFFF;\n  --danger: #B3261E;\n  --danger-dark: #8C1D16;\n  --danger-bg: #FBE9E4;\n  --success-bg: #E3F3EF;\n  --success-border: #2E7D6B;\n}\n* { box-sizing: border-box; }\nhtml { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; }\nbody {\n  font: 16px/1.6 \"Inter\", system-ui, sans-serif;\n  margin: 0;\n  color: var(--ink);\n  background: var(--paper);\n  overflow-wrap: anywhere;\n}\nh1, h2 { font-family: \"Fraunces\", Georgia, serif; line-height: 1.2; margin: 0 0 1rem; }\nh2 { font-size: 1.25rem; margin-top: 2rem; }\na { color: var(--purple-dark); }\n:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--gold); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 2px; }\n\nheader.site-header {\n  background: var(--purple);\n  padding: 0.85rem 1.5rem;\n}\nheader.site-header .brand {\n  color: #fff;\n  font-family: \"Fraunces\", Georgia, serif;\n  font-weight: 600;\n  font-size: 1.1rem;\n}\nmain { padding: 1.5rem; max-width: 68rem; margin: 0 auto; }\nfooter { padding: 1rem 1.5rem; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.85rem; }\n\n.flash {\n  background: var(--success-bg);\n  border: 1px solid var(--success-border);\n  color: #1c4038;\n  padding: 0.7rem 1rem;\n  border-radius: 0.5rem;\n  margin: 0 0 1.25rem;\n  font-weight: 600;\n}\n[role=\"alert\"] {\n  background: var(--danger-bg);\n  border: 1px solid var(--danger);\n  color: var(--danger-dark);\n  padding: 0.7rem 1rem;\n  border-radius: 0.5rem;\n  margin: 0 0 1.25rem;\n  font-weight: 600;\n}\n\n/* -- forms ------------------------------------------------------------- */\nform { margin: 0 0 1.25rem; }\nlabel { display: block; margin: 0 0 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--muted); }\ninput[type=\"text\"], input[type=\"email\"], input[type=\"password\"], select, textarea {\n  display: block;\n  margin-top: 0.3rem;\n  width: 100%;\n  max-width: 32rem;\n  font: inherit;\n  padding: 0.5rem 0.7rem;\n  border: 1px solid var(--border);\n  border-radius: 0.4rem;\n  background: #fff;\n  color: var(--ink);\n}\ninput[type=\"checkbox\"] { width: auto; display: inline-block; margin-right: 0.4rem; }\ntextarea { min-height: 9rem; font-family: ui-monospace, \"SFMono-Regular\", monospace; font-size: 0.9rem; }\ninput:focus, select:focus, textarea:focus { border-color: var(--purple); }\n\nbutton, .btn {\n  font: inherit;\n  font-weight: 600;\n  font-size: 0.95rem;\n  border: none;\n  border-radius: 999px;\n  padding: 0.5rem 1.2rem;\n  background: var(--purple);\n  color: #fff;\n  cursor: pointer;\n  text-decoration: none;\n  display: inline-block;\n}\nbutton:hover, .btn:hover { background: var(--purple-dark); }\nbutton.btn-danger { background: var(--danger); }\nbutton.btn-danger:hover { background: var(--danger-dark); }\n\n.post-preview, .preview-pane {\n  border: 1px solid var(--border);\n  border-radius: 0.6rem;\n  padding: 1rem 1.25rem;\n  background: #fff;\n  max-width: 40rem;\n}\n\n/* -- lists standing in for tables --------------------------------------- */\nul { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }\nmain ul li {\n  display: flex;\n  flex-wrap: wrap;\n  align-items: center;\n  gap: 0.6rem;\n  padding: 0.7rem 0.9rem;\n  border: 1px solid var(--border);\n  border-radius: 0.5rem;\n  margin: 0 0 0.6rem;\n  background: #fff;\n}\nmain ul li form { margin: 0; }\n\n/* The Page hierarchy tree nests arbitrarily deep — indent it instead of\n   boxing every level like a flat row list. */\n.page-tree, .page-tree ul { padding-left: 0; }\n.page-tree li, .page-tree li li {\n  display: block;\n  border: none;\n  background: none;\n  padding: 0.3rem 0 0.3rem 0.9rem;\n  margin: 0;\n  border-left: 2px solid var(--border);\n}\n\n/* -- the Staff/Ambassador console shell --------------------------------- */\n.console { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0; }\n.console-sidebar {\n  flex: 0 0 15rem;\n  background: var(--purple-light);\n  border-radius: 0.6rem;\n  padding: 1.1rem;\n  margin-right: 1.75rem;\n}\n.console-sidebar p { margin: 0 0 0.6rem; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--muted); }\n.console-sidebar nav ul { margin-top: 0.75rem; }\n.console-sidebar nav li {\n  display: block; border: none; background: none; padding: 0; margin: 0 0 0.25rem;\n}\n.console-sidebar nav a {\n  display: block;\n  padding: 0.45rem 0.6rem;\n  border-radius: 0.4rem;\n  color: var(--purple-dark);\n  font-weight: 600;\n  text-decoration: none;\n}\n.console-sidebar nav a:hover { background: #fff; }\n.console-main { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }\n\n@media (max-width: 30rem) {\n  main { padding: 1rem; }\n  .console { flex-direction: column; }\n  .console-sidebar { flex: none; width: 100%; margin: 0 0 1.25rem; Every\n`app/routes/*.py` module except `public.py` uses this (the public site has\nits own, unrelated live-preview chrome in `app/routes/public.py`).\n\nIssue #13: the admin console's stylesheet link is relative and\ndepth-computed (see app.services.css_path) rather than root-absolute —\na literal `href=\"/...\"` would still work on this live server, but\n`scripts/check_submission.py` greps every tracked template for\nroot-absolute paths regardless of whether the page is ever statically\nexported, so this stays relative like everything else.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom urllib.parse import quote\n\nfrom fastapi import Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import models\nfrom app.routes.auth import ensure_csrf_token\nfrom app.services.css_path import css_path_for\n\nSIDEBAR = [\n    (\"/admin/dashboard\", \"Dashboard\"),\n    (\"/admin/content\", \"Content list\"),\n    (\"/admin/pending\", \"Pending queue\"),\n    (\"/admin/accounts\", \"Accounts\"),\n    (\"/admin/pages\", \"Page hierarchy\"),\n    (\"/admin/metrics\", \"Metrics\"),\n]\n\nEDITOR_SIDEBAR = [\n    (\"/admin\", \"My posts\"),\n]\n\n\ndef css_path_for(request: Request) -> str:\n    depth = len([s for s in request.url.path.strip(\"/\").split(\"/\") if s]) - 1\n    return \"../\" * max(depth, 0) + \"style.css\"\n\n\ndef console_context(request: Request, user: models.User, sidebar=None) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"The csrf token, stylesheet path, and sidebar every authenticated\n    admin screen needs. Defaults the sidebar by role (Staff vs Ambassador)\n    so most call sites don't have to pick one themselves.\"\"\"\n    chosen = sidebar or (SIDEBAR if user.role == \"admin\" else EDITOR_SIDEBAR)\n    return {\n        \"user\": user,\n        \"csrf_token\": ensure_csrf_token(request),\n        \"css_path\": css_path_for(request),\n        \"sidebar\": [{\"href\": href, \"label\": label} for href, label in chosen],\n    }\n\n\ndef redirect_with_flash(url: str, message: str) -> RedirectResponse:\n    \"\"\"A 303 redirect carrying a one-time success message, read back by\n    templates/base.html's `request.query_params`. No session state: a\n    refresh of the destination page just drops the message, which is fine\n    for a \"your save worked\" banner.\"\"\"\n    sep = \"&\" if \"?\" in url else \"?\"\n    return RedirectResponse(url=f\"{url}{sep}flash={quote(message)}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n# Reuses the public site's Kenyon purple + gold palette and Fraunces/Inter\n# fonts (app/publish.py's CSS) for a consistent look, but is otherwise\n# self-contained: the admin console's HTML (sidebar, forms, plain <ul> lists\n# standing in for tables) is different enough from the public site's that\n# sharing one stylesheet would mean every admin rule risks colliding with a\n# public one, or vice versa.\nADMIN_CSS = \"\"\"/* Admin console shell — issue #13. }\nhtml { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; }\nbody {\n  font: 16px/1.6 \"Inter\", system-ui, sans-serif;\n  margin: 0;\n  color: var(--ink);\n  background: var(--paper);\n  overflow-wrap: anywhere;\n}\nh1, h2 { font-family: \"Fraunces\", Georgia, serif; }\n\nheader.site-header {\n  background: var(--purple);\n  padding: 0.85rem 1.5rem;\n}\nheader.site-header .brand {\n  color: #fff;\n  font-family: \"Fraunces\", Georgia, serif;\n  font-weight: 600;\n  font-size: 1.1rem;\n}\nmain { padding: 1.5rem; max-width: 68rem; margin: 0 auto; }\nfooter { padding: 1rem 1.5rem; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.85rem; }\n\n.flash {\n  background: var(--success-bg);\n  border: 1px solid var(--success-border);\n  color: #1c4038;\n  padding: 0.7rem 1rem;\n  border-radius: 0.5rem;\n  margin: 0 0 1.25rem;\n  font-weight: 600;\n}\n[role=\"alert\"] {\n  background: var(--danger-bg);\n  border: 1px solid var(--danger);\n  color: var(--danger-dark);\n  padding: 0.7rem 1rem;\n  border-radius: 0.5rem;\n  margin: 0 0 1.25rem;\n  font-weight: 600;\n}\n\n/* -- forms ------------------------------------------------------------- */\nform { margin: 0 0 1.25rem; fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.services import console_shell, csrf, passwords\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\nGENERIC_LOGIN_ERROR = \"Incorrect email or password.\"\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised by `require_user` for an anonymous request; caught in app/main.py.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass AdminRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised by `require_admin` for a ensure_csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Make sure the session has a CSRF token, and return it for the form.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not token:\n submitted = form.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    session_token = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not csrf.tokens_match(session_token, submitted):\n        raise CsrfInvalid()\n\n\ndef get_current_user(request: Request) -> models.User | None:\n    user_id = request.session.get(\"user_id\")\n    if user_id is None:\n        return None\n    user = models.get_user_by_id(user_id)\n     )","originalFile":"\"\"\"Login, logout, and the reusable login-required / admin-required gate.\n\nSession state lives in the signed session cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware,\nitsdangerous-backed): `user_id` once logged in, and `csrf_token` for the\ndouble-submit CSRF check on every state-changing form.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.services import csrf, passwords\nfrom app.services.css_path import css_path_for\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\nGENERIC_LOGIN_ERROR = \"Incorrect email or password.\"\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised by `require_user` for an anonymous request; caught in app/main.py.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass AdminRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised by `require_admin` for a non-admin request; caught in app/main.py.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass CsrfInvalid(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised by `verify_csrf` for a missing or wrong token; caught in app/main.py.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef ensure_csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Make sure the session has a CSRF token, and return it for the form.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not token:\n        token = csrf.generate_token()\n        request.session[\"csrf_token\"] = token\n    return token\n\n\nasync def verify_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    form = await request.form()\n    submitted = form.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    session_token = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not csrf.tokens_match(session_token, submitted):\n        raise CsrfInvalid()\n\n\ndef get_current_user(request: Request) -> models.User | None:\n    user_id = request.session.get(\"user_id\")\n    if user_id is None:\n        return None\n    user = models.get_user_by_id(user_id)\n    if user is None or not user.active:\n        return None\n    return user\n\n\ndef require_user(request: Request) -> models.User:\n    user = get_current_user(request)\n    if user is None:\n        raise LoginRequired()\n    return user\n\n\ndef require_admin(user: models.User = Depends(require_user)) -> models.User:\n    if user.role != \"admin\":\n        raise AdminRequired()\n    return user\n\n\n@router.get(\"/login\")\ndef login_form(request: Request):\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/login.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Log in\", \"csrf_token\": token, \"error\": None,\n         \"css_path\": css_path_for(request)},\n    )\n\n\n@router.post(\"/login\")\nasync def login_submit(\n    request: Request,\n    email: str = Form(...),\n    password: str = Form(...),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    user = models.get_user_by_email(email)\n    if user is None or not user.active or not passwords.verify_password(\n        user.password_hash, password\n    ):\n        if user is None or not user.active:\n            passwords.waste_time_like_a_verify(password)\n        token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/login.html\",\n            {\"title\": \"Log in\", \"csrf_token\": token, \"error\": GENERIC_LOGIN_ERROR},\n            status_code=401,\n        )\n\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"user_id\"] = user.id\n    request.session[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf.generate_token()\n    return RedirectResponse(url=\"/admin\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/logout\")\nasync def logout(request: Request, _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf)):\n    request.session.clear()\n    return RedirectResponse(url=\"/login\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/_stub\")\ndef admin_only_stub(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/stub.html\", {\"title\": \"Admin-only stub\", \"user\": user},\n import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom a role, activate/deactivate —\nStaff-only (require_admin, same gate as Pages — an Ambassador is blocked from\nevery route in this module, an anonymous request redirected to /login).\n\nDeactivation applies the role-specific cascade from\napp.services.deactivation via models.deactivate_user; this module just\nresolves the user and persists the result.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import require_admin, verify_csrf\nfrom app.services import console_shell\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/accounts\")\n\nROLE_CHOICES = [(\"admin\", \"Staff\"), (\"editor\", \"Ambassador\")]\nROLE_VALUES = {value for value, _label in ROLE_CHOICES}\n\n\ndef _get_user_or_404(user_id: int) -> models.User:\n    user = models.get_user_by_id(user_id)\n    if user is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such user\")\n    return user\n\n\ndef _render_new_form(\n    request: Request, user: models.User, error: str | None, email: str,\n    display_name: str, role: str, status_code: int = 200,\n):\n    context = console_shell.console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\n        \"title\": \"New account\",\n        \"error\": error,\n        \"roles\": ROLE_CHOICES,\n        \"form_email\": email,\n        \"form_display_name\": display_name,\n        \"form_role\": role,\n    })\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/accounts_form.html\", context, status_code=status_code,\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef list_accounts(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    context = console_shell.console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"Accounts\", \"users\": models.list_users()})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/accounts_list.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/new\")\ndef new_account_form(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    return _render_new_form(request, user, error=None, email=\"\", display_name=\"\", role=\"editor\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{user_id}/edit\")\ndef edit_account_form(\n    request: Request, user_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)\n):\n    target = _get_user_or_404(user_id)\n    context = console_shell.console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"Change role\", \"target\": target, \"roles\": ROLE_CHOICES})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/accounts_edit.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{user_id}/edit\")\nasync def update_account_role(\n    user_id: int,\n    role: str = Form(...),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    _get_user_or_404(user_id)\n    if role not in ROLE_VALUES:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"Invalid role\")\n    models.set_user_role(user_id, role)\n    return RedirectResponse(url=\"/admin/accounts\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/new\")\nasync def create_account(\n    request: Request,\n    email: str = Form(\"\"),\n    display_name: str = Form(\"\"),\n    password: str = Form(\"\"),\n    role: str = Form(\"editor\"),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    if role not in ROLE_VALUES:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"Invalid role\")\n    if not email.strip() or not display_name.strip() or not password:\n        return _render_new_form(\n            request, error=\"Email, display name, and password are all required.\",\n            email=email, display_name=display_name, role=role, status_code=400,\n        )\n    try:\n        models.create_user(\n            email=email, password=password, role=role, display_name=display_name,\n        )\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n        return _render_new_form(\n            request, error=\"An account with that email already exists.\",\n            email=email, display_name=display_name, role=role, status_code=400,\n        )\n    return RedirectResponse(url=\"/admin/accounts\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{user_id}/deactivate\")\nasync def deactivate_account(\n    user_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    _get_user_or_404(user_id)\n    models.deactivate_user(user_id)\n    return RedirectResponse(url=\"/admin/accounts\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{user_id}/reactivate\")\nasync def reactivate_account(\n    user_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    _get_user_or_404(user_id)\n    models.reactivate_user(user_id)\n    return RedirectResponse(url=\"/admin/accounts\", just\nresolves the user and persists the result.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import require_admin, verify_csrf\nfrom app.services import console_shell\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/accounts\")\n\nROLE_CHOICES = [(\"admin\", \"Staff\"), (\"editor\", \"Ambassador\")]\nROLE_VALUES = {value for value, _label in ROLE_CHOICES}\n\n\ndef _get_user_or_404(user_id: int) -> models.User:\n    user = models.get_user_by_id(user_id)\n    if user is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such user\")\n    return user\n\n\ndef _render_new_form(\n    request: Request, user: models.User, error: str | None, email: str,\n    display_name: str, role: str, status_code: int = 200,\n):\n    context = console_shell.console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\n        \"title\": \"New account\",\n        \"error\": error,\n        \"roles\": ROLE_CHOICES,\n        \"form_email\": email,\n        \"form_display_name\": display_name,\n        \"form_role\": role,\n    })\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/accounts_form.html\", context, status_code=status_code,\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef list_accounts(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    context = \"admin/accounts_list.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/new\")\ndef new_account_form(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    return _render_new_form(request, user, error=None, email=\"\", display_name=\"\", role=\"editor\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{user_id}/edit\")\ndef edit_account_form(\n    request: Request, user_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)\n):\n    target = _get_user_or_404(user_id)\n    context = console_shell.console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"Change role\", \"target\": target, \"roles\": ROLE_CHOICES})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/accounts_edit.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{user_id}/edit\")\nasync def update_account_role(\n    user_id: int,\n    role: str = Form(...),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    _get_user_or_404(user_id)\n    if role not in ROLE_VALUES:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"Invalid role\")\n    models.set_user_role(user_id, role)\n    return console_shell.redirect_with_flash(\"/admin/accounts\", \"Role updated.\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/new\")\nasync def create_account(\n    request: Request,\n    email: str = Form(\"\"),\n    display_name: str = Form(\"\"),\n    password: str = Form(\"\"),\n    role: str = Form(\"editor\"),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    if role not in ROLE_VALUES:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"Invalid role\")\n    if not email.strip() or not display_name.strip() or not password:\n        return _render_new_form(\n            request, error=\"Email, display name, and password are role=role, display_name=display_name,\n        )\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n        return _render_new_form(\n            request, error=\"An account with that email already exists.\",\n            email=email, display_name=display_name, role=role, status_code=400,\n        )\n    return RedirectResponse(url=\"/admin/accounts\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{user_id}/deactivate\")\nasync def deactivate_account(\n    user_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    _csrf: None = user and persists the result.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import require_admin, verify_csrf\nfrom app.services import console_shell\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/accounts\")\n\nROLE_CHOICES = [(\"admin\", \"Staff\"), (\"editor\", \"Ambassador\")]\nROLE_VALUES = {value for value, _label in ROLE_CHOICES}\n\n\ndef _get_user_or_404(user_id: int) -> models.User:\n    user = models.get_user_by_id(user_id)\n    if user is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such user\")\n    return user\n\n\ndef _render_new_form(\n    request: Request, user: models.User, error: str | None, email: str,\n    display_name: str, role: str, status_code: int = 200,\n):\n    context = console_shell.console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\n        \"title\": \"New account\",\n        \"error\": error,\n        \"roles\": ROLE_CHOICES,\n        \"form_email\": email,\n        \"form_display_name\": display_name,\n        \"form_role\": role,\n    })\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/accounts_form.html\", context, status_code=status_code,\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef list_accounts(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    context = console_shell.console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"Accounts\", \"users\": models.list_users()})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/accounts_list.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/new\")\ndef new_account_form(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    return _render_new_form(request, user, error=None, email=\"\", display_name=\"\", role=\"editor\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{user_id}/edit\")\ndef edit_account_form(\n    request: Request, user_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)\n):\n    target = _get_user_or_404(user_id)\n    context = console_shell.console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"Change role\", \"target\": target, \"roles\": ROLE_CHOICES})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/accounts_edit.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{user_id}/edit\")\nasync def update_account_role(\n    user_id: int,\n    role: str = Form(...),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    _get_user_or_404(user_id)\n    if role not in ROLE_VALUES:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"Invalid role\")\n    models.set_user_role(user_id, role)\n    return console_shell.redirect_with_flash(\"/admin/accounts\", \"Role updated.\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/new\")\nasync def create_account(\n    request: Request,\n    email: str = Form(\"\"),\n    display_name: str = Form(\"\"),\n    password: str = Form(\"\"),\n    role: str = Form(\"editor\"),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    if role not in ROLE_VALUES:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"Invalid role\")\n    if not email.strip() or not display_name.strip() or not password:\n        return _render_new_form(\n            request, user, error=\"Email, display name, and password \"title\": \"Edit page\" if page else \"New page\",\n            \"page\": page,\n            \"parent\": parent,\n            \"csrf_token\": token,\n            \"error\": error,\n        },\n return [\n            {\"page\": child, \"children\": tree(child)}\n            for child in models.list_children(page.id)\n        ]\n\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return )\n\n\n@router.get(\"/new\")\ndef new_page_form(\n    request: Request, parent_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)\n):\n    return _render_form(request, page=None, parent_id=page.parent_id)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{page_id}/edit\")\nasync def update_page(\n    request: Request,\n    page_id: int,\n    title: str = Form(...),\n    body: str = Form(\"\"),\n def create_page(\n    request: Request,\n    parent_id: int = Form(...),\n    title: str = Form(...),\n    body: str = Form(\"\"),\n    show_in_footer: str | None = Form(None),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    _get_page_or_404(parent_id)\n    if not title.strip():\n        return _render_form(request, page=None, parent_id=parent_id,\n                             error=\"Title is required.\")\n    models.create_page(\n        parent_id=parent_id, title=title, body=body,\n        show_in_footer=bool(show_in_footer), author_id=user.id,\n    )\n    return RedirectResponse(url=\"/admin/pages\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{page_id}/edit\")\ndef edit_page_form(\n    request: Request, page_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)\n):\n    page = _get_page_or_404(page_id)\n    return _render_form(request, page=page, parent_id=page.parent_id)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{page_id}/edit\")\nasync def update_page(\n    request: Request,\n    page_id: int,\n    title: str = Form(...),\n    body: str = Form(\"\"),\n    show_in_footer: str | None = Form(None),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    page = _get_page_or_404(page_id)\n    if not title.strip():\n        return _render_form(request, page=page, parent_id=page.parent_id,\n                             error=\"Title is required.\")\n    models.update_page(page_id, title=title, body=body, show_in_footer=bool(show_in_footer))\n    return RedirectResponse(url=\"/admin/pages\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{page_id}/publish\")\nasync def publish_page(\n    page_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    _get_page_or_404(page_id)\n    models.publish_page(page_id)\n    return RedirectResponse(url=\"/admin/pages\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{page_id}/delete\")\ndef confirm_delete_page(\n    request: Request, page_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)\n):\n    page = _get_page_or_404(page_id)\n    if page.parent_id is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"Cannot delete the Home page\")\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/pages_delete.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Delete page?\", \"page\": page, \"csrf_token\": token},\n    )\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{page_id}/delete\")\nasync def delete_page(\n    page_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    try:\n The submit/publish/bounce/\nunpublish transitions delegate every allow/deny decision to\napp.services.review_gate, so this module just resolves the Post, asks the\nservice whether the action is allowed, and persists the result.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import ensure_csrf_token, require_user, verify_csrf\nfrom app.services import markdown, review_gate\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/posts\")\n\n\ndef _get_program_or_404(program_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    \"\"\"Resolve program_id, rejecting up front if it isn't a Program-level\n    Page — otherwise a user could fill out the whole new-post form before\n    hitting the same rejection as a save-time error (models.create_post\n    still checks this too, as the model layer's own guarantee).\"\"\"\n    program = models.get_page_by_id(program_id)\n    if program is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such program page\")\n    if not models.is_program_page(program):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"Not a Program-level page\")\n    return program\n\n\ndef _get_post_or_404(post_id: int) -> models.Post:\n    post = models.get_post_by_id(post_id)\n    if post is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such post\")\n    return post\n\n\ndef _authorize_post_write(user: models.User, post: models.Post) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Admin: any Post, any status. Editor: only their own, only while draft.\"\"\"\n    if user.role == \"admin\":\n        return\n    if post.author_id != user.id or post.status != \"draft\":\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Forbidden\")\n\n\ndef _apply_transition(user: models.User, post: models.Post, action: str) -> models.Post:\n    \"\"\"Ask review_gate whether `action` is allowed, then persist its answer.\n\n    review_gate.transition raises ValueError -> 403 (not allowed at all).\n    models.set_post_status raises StatusConflict -> 409 (it *was* allowed\n    against the status we read, but another request changed it first).\n    \"\"\"\n    is_author = post.author_id == user.id\n    try:\n        new_status = review_gate.transition(post.status, action, user.role, is_author)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=str(exc))\n    try:\n        return models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=post.status, to_status=new_status)\n    except models.StatusConflict as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(exc))\n\n\ndef _render_form(\n    request: Request,\n    post: models.Post | None,\n    program: models.Page,\n    error: str | None = None,\n    title: str = \"\",\n    body: str = \"\",\n    topic: str = \"general\",\n):\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/posts_form.html\",\n        {\n            \"title\": \"Edit post\" if post else \"New post\",\n            \"post\": post,\n            \"program\": program,\n            \"csrf_token\": token,\n            \"error\": error,\n            \"form_title\": title,\n            \"form_body\": body,\n            \"form_topic\": topic,\n            \"preview_html\": markdown.render(body),\n            \"topics\": models.TOPIC_CHOICES,\n        },\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef list_posts(\n    request: Request, program_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    program = _get_program_or_404(program_id)\n    posts = models.list_posts_by_program(program_id)\n    if user.role != \"admin\":\n        posts = [p for p in posts if p.author_id == user.id]\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    posts_with_actions = [\n        (\n            post,\n            [\n                (action, review_gate.ACTION_LABELS[action])\n                for action in review_gate.available_actions(\n                    post.status, user.role, post.author_id == user.id\n                )\n            ],\n        )\n        for post in posts\n    ]\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/posts_list.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Posts\", \"program\": program, \"posts_with_actions\": posts_with_actions,\n         \"csrf_token\": token},\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"/new\")\ndef new_post_form(\n    request: Request, program_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    program = _get_program_or_404(program_id)\n    return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/new\")\nasync def create_post(\n    request: Request,\n    program_id: int = Form(...),\n    title: str = Form(\"\"),\n    body: str = Form(\"\"),\n    topic: str = Form(\"general\"),\n    action: str = Form(\"save\"),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    program = _get_program_or_404(program_id)\n    if action == \"preview\":\n        return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program,\n                             title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    if not title.strip():\n        return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program,\n                             error=\"Title is required.\", title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    try:\n        models.create_post(\n            program_id=program_id, title=title, body=body, topic=topic, author_id=user.id,\n        )\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        return _render_form(request, post=None, program=program,\n                             error=str(exc), title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    return RedirectResponse(url=f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{post_id}/edit\")\ndef edit_post_form(\n    request: Request, post_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _authorize_post_write(user, post)\n    program = _get_program_or_404(post.program_id)\n    return _render_form(request, post=post, program=program,\n                         title=post.title, body=post.body, topic=post.topic)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/edit\")\nasync def update_post(\n    request: Request,\n    post_id: int,\n    title: str = Form(\"\"),\n    body: str = Form(\"\"),\n    topic: str = Form(\"general\"),\n    action: str = Form(\"save\"),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _authorize_post_write(user, post)\n    program = _get_program_or_404(post.program_id)\n    if action == \"preview\":\n        return _render_form(request, post=post, program=program,\n                             title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    if not title.strip():\n        return _render_form(request, post=post, program=program,\n                             error=\"Title is required.\", title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    try:\n        models.update_post(post_id, title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        return _render_form(request, post=post, program=program,\n                             error=str(exc), title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    return RedirectResponse(url=f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program.id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{post_id}/delete\")\ndef confirm_delete_post(\n    request: Request, post_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _authorize_post_write(user, post)\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/posts_delete.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Delete post?\", \"post\": post, \"csrf_token\": token},\n    )\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/delete\")\nasync def delete_post(\n    post_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _authorize_post_write(user, post)\n    program_id = post.program_id\n    models.delete_post(post_id)\n    return RedirectResponse(url=f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/submit\")\nasync def submit_post(\n    post_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _apply_transition(user, post, \"submit\")\n    return RedirectResponse(url=f\"/admin/posts?program_id={post.program_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/publish\")\nasync def publish_post(\n    post_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _apply_transition(user, post, \"publish\")\n    return RedirectResponse(url=f\"/admin/posts?program_id={post.program_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/bounce\")\nasync def bounce_post(\n    post_id: int, user: models.User = _render_form(request, user, post=None, program=program)","originalFile":"\"\"\"Post authoring: draft CRUD, Topic, a sanitized Markdown preview, and the\nADR-004 review-gate state machine (T04, #5).\n\nUnlike Pages (admin-only), Post authoring is open to any active user\n(require_user), with ownership enforced inside the route: an Ambassador\n(editor) may only touch their own Post, and only while it is draft; a Staff\nmember (admin) may touch any Post, same as Pages. The submit/publish/bounce/\nunpublish transitions delegate every allow/deny decision to\napp.services.review_gate, so this module just resolves the Post, asks the\nservice whether the action is allowed, and persists the result.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import require_user, verify_csrf\nfrom app.services import console_shell, markdown, review_gate\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/posts\")\n\n\ndef _get_program_or_404(program_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    \"\"\"Resolve program_id, rejecting up front if it isn't a Program-level\n    Page — otherwise a user could fill out the whole new-post form before\n    hitting the same rejection as a save-time error (models.create_post\n    still checks this too, as the model layer's own guarantee).\"\"\"\n    program = models.get_page_by_id(program_id)\n    if program is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such program page\")\n    if not models.is_program_page(program):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"Not a Program-level page\")\n    return program\n\n\ndef _get_post_or_404(post_id: int) -> models.Post:\n    post = models.get_post_by_id(post_id)\n    if post is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such post\")\n    return post\n\n\ndef _authorize_post_write(user: models.User, post: models.Post) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Admin: any Post, any status. Editor: only their own, only while draft.\"\"\"\n    if user.role == \"admin\":\n        return\n    if post.author_id != user.id or post.status != \"draft\":\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Forbidden\")\n\n\ndef _apply_transition(user: models.User, post: models.Post, action: str) -> models.Post:\n    \"\"\"Ask review_gate whether `action` is allowed, then persist its answer.\n\n    review_gate.transition raises ValueError -> 403 (not allowed at all).\n    models.set_post_status raises StatusConflict -> 409 (it *was* allowed\n    against the status we read, but another request changed it first).\n    \"\"\"\n    is_author = post.author_id == user.id\n    try:\n        new_status = review_gate.transition(post.status, action, user.role, is_author)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=str(exc))\n    try:\n        return models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=post.status, authoring is open to any active user\n(require_user), with ownership enforced inside the route: an Ambassador\n(editor) may only touch their own Post, and only while it is draft; a Staff\nmember (admin) may touch any Post, same as Pages. The submit/publish/bounce/\nunpublish transitions delegate every allow/deny decision to\napp.services.review_gate, so this module just resolves the Post, asks the\nservice whether the action is allowed, and persists the result.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import require_user, verify_csrf\nfrom app.services import console_shell, markdown, review_gate\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/posts\")\n\n\ndef _get_program_or_404(program_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    \"\"\"Resolve program_id, rejecting up front if it isn't a Program-level\n    Page — otherwise a user could fill out the whole new-post form before\n    hitting the same rejection as a save-time error (models.create_post\n    still checks this too, as the model layer's own guarantee).\"\"\"\n    program = models.get_page_by_id(program_id)\n    if program is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such program page\")\n    if not models.is_program_page(program):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"Not a Program-level page\")\n    return program\n\n\ndef _get_post_or_404(post_id: int) -> models.Post:\n    post = models.get_post_by_id(post_id)\n    if post is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such post\")\n    return post\n\n\ndef _authorize_post_write(user: models.User, post: models.Post) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Admin: any Post, any status. Editor: only their own, only while draft.\"\"\"\n    if user.role == \"admin\":\n        return\n    if post.author_id != user.id or post.status != \"draft\":\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Forbidden\")\n\n\ndef _apply_transition(user: models.User, post: models.Post, action: str) -> models.Post:\n    \"\"\"Ask review_gate whether `action` is allowed, then persist its answer.\n\n    review_gate.transition raises ValueError -> 403 (not allowed at all).\n    models.set_post_status raises StatusConflict -> 409 (it *was* allowed\n    against the status we read, but another request changed it first).\n    \"\"\"\n    is_author = post.author_id == user.id\n    try:\n        new_status = review_gate.transition(post.status, action, user.role, is_author)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=str(exc))\n    try:\n        return models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=post.status, to_status=new_status)\n    except models.StatusConflict as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(exc))\n\n\ndef _render_form(\n    request: Request,\n    user: models.User,\n models.TOPIC_CHOICES,\n    })\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/posts_form.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef list_posts(\n    request: Request, program_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    program = _get_program_or_404(program_id)\n    posts = models.list_posts_by_program(program_id)\n    if user.role != \"admin\":\n        posts = [p for p in posts if p.author_id == user.id]\n    posts_with_actions = [\n        (\n            post,\n            [\n                (action, review_gate.ACTION_LABELS[action])\n                for action in review_gate.available_actions(\n                    post.status, user.role, post.author_id == user.id\n                )\n            ],\n        )\n        for post in posts\n    ]\n    context = console_shell.console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"Posts\", \"program\": program,\n                     \"posts_with_actions\": posts_with_actions})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/posts_list.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/new\")\ndef new_post_form(\n    request: Request, program_id: int, user: models.User = request: Request,\n    program_id: int = Form(...),\n    title: str = Form(\"\"),\n    body: str = Form(\"\"),\n    topic: str = Form(\"general\"),\n    action: str = Form(\"save\"),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    program = _get_program_or_404(program_id)\n    if action == \"preview\":\n        return _render_form(request, {"parentUuid":"6f1e8e0b-b0fb-46e3-8a41-21ae9877a372","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"64239083-c66a-4955-99a7-d35d1d813ada","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01JfQsQddjaV6MmgCC9MuACU","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Page authoring: the Continent -> Country -> Program tree, admin-only.\n\nStaff-only (require_admin, see app/routes/auth.py): an Ambassador gets a 403,\nan anonymous request is redirected to /login, same gate proven on the T01\nstub route.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import require_admin, verify_csrf\nfrom app.services import console_shell\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/pages\")\n\n\n---\n\"\"\"Post authoring: draft CRUD, Topic, a sanitized Markdown preview, and the\nADR-004 review-gate state machine (T04, #5).\n\nUnlike Pages (admin-only), Post authoring is open to any active user\n(require_user), with ownership enforced inside the route: an Ambassador\n(editor) may only touch their own Post, and only while it is draft; a Staff\nmember (admin) may touch any Post, same as Pages. The submit/publish/bounce/\nunpublish transitions delegate every allow/deny decision to\napp.services.review_gate, so this module just resolves the Post, asks the\nservice whether the action is allowed, and persists the result.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import require_user, verify_csrf\nfrom app.services import console_shell, markdown, review_gate\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/posts\")","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"35889b12-fc70-411e-8911-0ec237ccc52b","timestamp":"2026-10-07T01:20:13.048Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"\"\"\"Page authoring: the Continent -> Country -> Program tree, admin-only.\n\nStaff-only (require_admin, see app/routes/auth.py): an Ambassador gets a 403,\nan anonymous request is redirected to /login, same gate proven on the T01\nstub route.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import require_admin, verify_csrf\nfrom app.services import console_shell\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/pages\")\n\n\n---\n\"\"\"Post authoring: draft CRUD, Topic, a sanitized Markdown preview, and the\nADR-004 review-gate state machine (T04, #5).\n\nUnlike Pages (admin-only), Post authoring is open to any active user\n(require_user), with ownership enforced inside the route: an Ambassador\n(editor) may only touch their own Post, and only while it is draft; a Staff\nmember (admin) may touch any Post, same as Pages. The submit/publish/bounce/\nunpublish transitions delegate every allow/deny decision to\napp.services.review_gate, so this module just resolves the Post, asks the\nservice whether the action is allowed, and persists the result.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import require_user, verify_csrf\nfrom app.services import console_shell, markdown, review_gate\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/posts\")","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"6f1e8e0b-b0fb-46e3-8a41-21ae9877a372","session_id":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

test_admin_stylesheet_is_served_at_a_fixed_url(client):\n    response = client.get(\"/style.css\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"text/css\" in response.headers[\"content-type\"]\n    assert \".console-sidebar\" in response.text\n\n\ndef test_nested_admin_pages_link_a_correctly_relative_stylesheet(client_as):\n    \"\"\"A literal root-absolute href would fail check_submission.py's scan of\n    every tracked template, so every admin page computes its own \"../\" depth\n    back to the one /style.css route instead (console_shell.css_path_for).\"\"\"\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    program = _seed_program(models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\").id)\n    post = models.create_post(\n        program_id=program.id, title=\"A post\", body=\"Body.\", topic=\"general\",\n        author_id=models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\").id,\n    )\n    for path in [\"/login\", \"/admin\", \"/admin/dashboard\", \"/admin/accounts\",\n                 f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\"]:\n        response = admin.get(path)\n        href = re.search(r'<link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"([^\"]+)\"', response.text).group(1)\n        assert not href.startswith(\"/\"), f\"{path}: root-absolute href {href!r}\"\n        resolved = urljoin(f\"http://testserver{path}\", href)\n        assert resolved == \"http://testserver/style.css\", (path, href, resolved)\n\n\ndef test_accounts_posts_and_pages_screens_have_the_persistent_sidebar(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    program = _seed_program(models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\").id)\n    post = models.create_post(\n        program_id=program.id, title=\"A post\", body=\"Body.\", topic=\"general\",\n Read CONTEXT.md first for vocabulary, then read GitHub issue #13 for the spec: `gh -C /home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms issue view 13`.\n\nRun `git -C /home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms status` and `git -C /home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms diff` to see everything. New/changed files include: app/services/console_shell.py (new), app/services/css_path.py (new), app/routes/auth.py, app/routes/accounts.py, app/routes/pages.py, app/routes/posts.py, app/routes/console.py, templates/base.html, templates/admin/*.html (several), tests/test_admin_shell.py (new). docs/screenshots/*.png are also new/changed but are binary — skip reviewing their pixel content, just confirm the set of 12 files exists with the right names.\n\n## Context on the bug and the fix\n\nThe admin console (login, dashboard, content list, post editor, accounts, page hierarchy, etc. — everything under templates/admin/ plus templates/base.html, which every admin template extends) previously rendered completely unstyled, because templates/base.html linked a stylesheet via a *literal relative* `href=\"{{ css_path | default('style.css') }}\"` that nothing ever populated with the right value — so it defaulted to the bare string \"style.css\", which resolves against whatever URL depth the current page happens to be at (e.g. `/admin/posts/20/edit` requests `/admin/posts/20/style.css`) and always 404s except at the site root.\n\nThe fix:\n1. `app/services/css_path.py`: `css_path_for(request)` computes the correct number of `\"../\"` prefixes from the request's own URL depth, so the link always resolves back to one fixed route.\n2. A new `GET /style.css` route is registered in `app/routes/console.py`, serving a new `ADMIN_CSS` constant (defined in `app/services/console_shell.py`) as `text/css`.\n3. `app/services/console_shell.py`'s `console_context(request, user, sidebar=None)` bundles `csrf_token` + `css_path` + a role-appropriate `sidebar` (Staff sees the full admin nav, Ambassador sees just \"My posts\") for every authenticated admin route to spread into its template context. It also provides `redirect_with_flash(url, message)`, a 303 redirect that appends `?flash=<message>` so templates/base.html can show a one-time success banner read from `request.query_params`.\n4. Every route in app/routes/{auth,accounts,pages,posts,console}.py was updated to supply `css_path` (pre-login screens) or the full `console_context(...)` (authenticated screens), and every successful mutating POST handler's redirect now goes through `redirect_with_flash` instead of a bare `RedirectResponse`.\n5. Templates that used to extend \"base.html\" directly and render inside `{% block content %}` — accounts_list.html, accounts_edit.html, accounts_form.html, posts_list.html, posts_form.html, posts_delete.html, pages_list.html, pages_form.html, pages_delete.html — now extend \"admin/console_base.html\" and render inside `{% block console_content %}`, so they pick up the persistent sidebar that only the \"console\" screens (dashboard, content list, pending queue, metrics, my posts, home/live-preview) had before. login.html, hello.html, and stub.html (a test-only harness page) were deliberately left extending \"base.html\" directly (no sidebar, since they're pre-login or test-only).\n6. posts_delete.html and pages_delete.html's \"Yes, delete it\" button got `class=\"btn-danger\"` for destructive-action styling.\n7. pages_list.html's recursive page-tree `<ul>` got `class=\"page-tree\"` so the CSS can indent nested levels instead of boxing every level like a flat row list.\n\nNote a deliberate circular-import avoidance: app/services/console_shell.py imports `ensure_csrf_token` from app/routes/auth.py, so app/routes/auth.py imports `css_path_for` from the separate app/services/css_path.py (not from console_shell) to avoid a cycle.\n\n## What to check\n\n1. **Spec match against issue #13's acceptance criteria.**\n2. **Correctness of css_path_for's depth math** — trace it for `/login` (depth 0), `/admin` (depth 0), `/admin/accounts` (depth 1), `/admin/posts/20/edit` (depth 3), `/admin/pages/5/edit` (depth 2) and confirm each resolves correctly against the fixed `/style.css` route.\n3. **No root-absolute paths were introduced** in any template (`grep -rn 'href=\"/\\|src=\"/' templates/`) — this is a hard repo constraint (CLAUDE.md) checked by scripts/check_submission.py regardless of whether admin is ever statically exported.\n4. **Every admin route that renders a template was actually updated** — cross-check every `TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/...\")` call site in app/routes/*.py against whether its context dict now includes `css_path` (or the full console_context). Look especially for any call site I might have missed.\n5. **CSRF**: confirm every POST form still carries a csrf_token (console_context still provides it) and that verify_csrf dependencies weren't disturbed.\n6. **The flash-message mechanism**: confirm `redirect_with_flash` URL-encodes the message safely (no injection risk via `| safe` or unescaped rendering — Jinja autoescapes by default, confirm nothing bypasses that for the flash text), and that it doesn't break on a redirect URL that already has a query string (e.g. `/admin/posts?program_id=5`).\n7. **Tests**: run `cd /home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms && uv run pytest -q` (expect 170 passed) and `uv run python scripts/check_submission.py --stage 1` (expect 11/12, \"no secrets in history\" is a known pre-existing unrelated failure, don't flag it). Read tests/test_admin_shell.py and judge whether it actually exercises the acceptance criteria meaningfully or is superficial.\n8. **Unintended side effects**: did switching accounts/posts/pages templates to extend console_base.html break anything for an Ambassador (editor role) hitting posts_form.html/posts_list.html, which editors ARE allowed to reach (unlike accounts/pages, which are admin-only)? Check that console_context's role-based sidebar default works correctly when a non-admin user hits those shared templates.\n\nDo NOT fix anything — review only. Report: a short spec-match paragraph, then findings ranked by severity with file:line and a concrete failure scenario for each. If nothing blocking, say so explicitly. The user can send it another message and resume it, so the same task-id may notify more than once.</note>\n<result>## Review: Issue #13 — admin console stylesheet fix\n\n**Spec match:** The change fully satisfies issue #13's four acceptance criteria. `css_path_for` makes `/style.css` resolve correctly from every admin route depth; `GET /style.css` serves `ADMIN_CSS` at 200 with `text/css`; the CSS matches the public site's Kenyon purple/gold + Fraunces/Inter language with a sidebar, styled forms/tables/buttons, a flash banner, and a `btn-danger` delete confirmation; a `@media (max-width: 30rem)` rule stacks the sidebar and removes fixed widths for the 390px requirement; and `tests/test_admin_shell.py` includes a nested-page stylesheet-resolution test. All 170 tests pass, and `check_submission.py --stage 1` is 11/12 with only the known pre-existing \"no secrets in history\" failure.\n\n**Depth math** traced and correct for every live route: `/login`→0, `/admin`→0, `/admin/accounts`→1, `/admin/posts/{id}/edit`→3, `/admin/pages/{id}/edit`→3 (the ticket's own \"depth 2\" note for that last one is wrong — `/admin/pages/{id}/edit` has the same 4-segment shape as the posts route and is depth 3 — but the implementation itself still resolves to the correct `/style.css` either way, since `css_path_for` derives depth from `request.url.path` directly rather than from any hardcoded table).\n\n**No findings are blocking.** Specifics:\n\n- No root-absolute `href=\"/` or `src=\"/` anywhere in `templates/` (verified by grep) — the hard constraint holds.\n- Every `TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/...\")` call site across `app/routes/{auth,accounts,pages,posts,console}.py` supplies either `css_path` or full `console_context`; cross-checked all 20 call sites, none missed.\n- Every `&lt;form method=\"post\"&gt;` in `templates/admin/*.html` carries a `csrf_token` hidden input (checked programmatically, no exceptions).\n- `redirect_with_flash` URL-encodes via `urllib.parse.quote` and correctly branches `?`/`&amp;` for URLs that already have a query string (e.g. `/admin/posts?program_id=5&amp;flash=...`). The flash is rendered as plain `{{ flash }}` text in `templates/base.html` with Jinja's default autoescaping active (FastAPI's `Jinja2Templates` defaults to `select_autoescape`); no `| safe` is applied to flash anywhere — the only `| safe` usages in the repo are sanitized Markdown HTML and the server-side CSS constant, unrelated to flash.\n- Role-based sidebar default in `console_shell.console_context` works correctly for the shared `posts_form.html`/`posts_list.html` templates: an Ambassador (editor) hitting those routes gets `EDITOR_SIDEBAR` (My posts only), Staff get the full `SIDEBAR` — verified both in `app/routes/posts.py` (which never overrides the `sidebar=` argument) and in `tests/test_admin_shell.py`'s `test_ambassador_sidebar_only_lists_my_posts`.\n- `pages_delete.html`/`posts_delete.html` use `action=\"/admin/pages/{id}/delete\"` (root-absolute `action`, not `href`/`src`) — this matches the pre-existing convention already used in `console_base.html` (`action=\"/logout\"`), `login.html`, and `content_list.html`, and `check_submission.py` only greps `href=\"/` / `src=\"/\"`, so this is consistent with existing style, not a regression.\n- The recursive `.page-tree` CSS (`templates/admin/pages_list.html` + the new CSS block) does compound indentation correctly per nesting level — each `&lt;li&gt;`'s own `padding-left: 0.9rem` nests inside its parent's content box, so depth increases visually by 0.9rem per level despite every nested `&lt;ul&gt;` also carrying the `page-tree` class.\n- `tests/test_admin_shell.py` is meaningful, not superficial: it hits actual routes with a real logged-in client, asserts href-resolution via `urllib.parse.urljoin` (not just string matching), checks role-conditional sidebar content, and checks the flash banner appears after a real mutating POST. All 170 tests pass, and `check_submission.py --stage 1` is 11/12 with only the known pre-existing \"no secrets in history\" failure.\n\n**Depth math** traced and correct for every live route: `/login`→0, `/admin`→0, `/admin/accounts`→1, `/admin/posts/{id}/edit`→3, `/admin/pages/{id}/edit`→3 (the ticket's own \"depth 2\" note for that last one is wrong — `/admin/pages/{id}/edit` has the same 4-segment shape as the posts route and is depth 3 — but the implementation itself still resolves to the correct `/style.css` either way, since `css_path_for` derives depth from `request.url.path` directly rather than from any hardcoded table).\n\n**No findings are blocking.** Specifics:\n\n- No root-absolute `href=\"/` or `src=\"/` anywhere in `templates/` (verified by grep) — the hard constraint holds.\n- Every `TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/...\")` call site across `app/routes/{auth,accounts,pages,posts,console}.py` supplies either `css_path` or full `console_context`; cross-checked all 20 call sites, none missed.\n- Every `&lt;form method=\"post\"&gt;` in `templates/admin/*.html` carries a `csrf_token` hidden input (checked programmatically, no exceptions).\n- `redirect_with_flash` URL-encodes via `urllib.parse.quote` and correctly branches `?`/`&amp;` for URLs that already have a query string (e.g. `/admin/posts?program_id=5&amp;flash=...`). The flash is rendered as plain `{{ flash }}` text in `templates/base.html` with Jinja's default autoescaping active (FastAPI's `Jinja2Templates` defaults to `select_autoescape`); no `| safe` is applied to flash anywhere — the only `| safe` usages in the repo are sanitized Markdown HTML and the server-side CSS constant, unrelated to flash.\n- Role-based sidebar default in `console_shell.console_context` works correctly for the shared `posts_form.html`/`posts_list.html` templates: an Ambassador (editor) hitting those routes gets `EDITOR_SIDEBAR` (My posts only), Staff get the full `SIDEBAR` — verified both in `app/routes/posts.py` (which never overrides the `sidebar=` argument) and in `tests/test_admin_shell.py`'s `test_ambassador_sidebar_only_lists_my_posts`.\n- `pages_delete.html`/`posts_delete.html` use `action=\"/admin/pages/{id}/delete\"` (root-absolute `action`, not `href`/`src`) — this matches the pre-existing convention already used in `console_base.html` (`action=\"/logout\"`), `login.html`, and `content_list.html`, and `check_submission.py` only greps `href=\"/` / `src=\"/\"`, so this is consistent with existing style, not a regression.\n- The recursive `.page-tree` CSS (`templates/admin/pages_list.html` + the new CSS block) does compound indentation correctly per nesting level — each `&lt;li&gt;`'s own `padding-left: 0.9rem` nests inside its parent's content box, so depth increases visually by 0.9rem per level despite every nested `&lt;ul&gt;` also carrying the `page-tree` class.\n- `tests/test_admin_shell.py` is meaningful, not superficial: it hits actual routes with a real logged-in client, asserts href-resolution via `urllib.parse.urljoin` (not just string matching), checks role-conditional sidebar content, and checks the flash banner appears after a real mutating POST. One minor gap: the acceptance criterion \"asserts the admin stylesheet returns 200 from a nested admin page\" is covered by two separate tests (one fetches `/style.css` directly and checks 200; another proves a nested page's `href` resolves to that exact URL) rather than one test that fetches the resolved href from a nested-page context and checks 200 directly — functionally equivalent, but not a single literal assertion of that exact scenario.\n- All 12 `docs/screenshots/*.png` exist with the expected `{login,dashboard,content_list,post_editor,refused,users}_{1280,390}.png` naming; binary content not reviewed per instructions.\n\nFiles reviewed: `/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/services/css_path.py`, `/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/services/console_shell.py`, `/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/routes/{auth,console,pages,posts,accounts}.py`, `/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/templates/base.html`, `/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/templates/admin/console_base.html`, `/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/templates/admin/{accounts_edit,accounts_form,accounts_list,pages_delete,pages_form,pages_list,posts_delete,posts_form,posts_list,login,hello,stub}.html`, `/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_admin_shell.py`.</result>\n<usage><subagent_tokens>84081</subagent_tokens><tool_uses>32</tool_uses><duration_ms>254542</duration_ms></usage>\n</task-notification>"},"uuid":"02882f06-8f28-435c-8b58-edde59120ee7","timestamp":"2026-10-07T01:29:32.840Z","permissionMode":"bypassPermissions","origin":{"kind":"task-notification"},"promptSource":"system","queueSkipAttachments":true,"userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

_csrf_token_from(html: str) -> str:\n    match = re.search(r'name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"([^\"]+)\"', html)\n    return match.group(1) if match else \"\"\n\n\ndef _seed_program(author_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continent = models.create_page(home.id, \"Asia\", \"\", False, author_id)\n    country = models.create_page(continent.id, \"Japan\", \"\", False, author_id)\n    return models.create_page(country.id, \"Kyoto Exchange\", \"\", False, author_id)\n\n\ndef test_admin_stylesheet_is_served_at_a_fixed_url(client):\n    response = client.get(\"/style.css\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"text/css\" in response.headers[\"content-type\"]\n    assert \".console-sidebar\" in response.text\n\n\ndef test_nested_admin_pages_link_a_correctly_relative_stylesheet(client_as):\n    \"\"\"A literal root-absolute href would fail check_submission.py's scan of\n    every tracked template, so every admin page computes its own \"../\" depth\n    back to the one /style.css route instead (console_shell.css_path_for).\"\"\"\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    program = author_id=models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\").id,\n    )\n    for path in [\"/login\", \"/admin\", \"/admin/dashboard\", \"/admin/accounts\",\n href.startswith(\"/\"), f\"{path}: root-absolute href {href!r}\"\n        resolved = urljoin(f\"http://testserver{path}\", href)\n        assert resolved == \"http://testserver/style.css\", (path, href, resolved)\n\n\ndef test_accounts_posts_and_pages_screens_have_the_persistent_sidebar(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    program = _seed_program(models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\").id)\n    post = models.create_post(\n        program_id=program.id, title=\"A post\", body=\"Body.\", topic=\"general\",\n        author_id=models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\").id,\n    )\n    for path in [\"/admin/accounts\", \"/admin/pages\", f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\"]:\n        response = admin.get(path)\n        assert 'class=\"console-sidebar\"' in response.text, path\n        assert \">Dashboard<\" in response.text, path\n\n\ndef test_ambassador_sidebar_only_lists_my_posts(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    response = editor.get(\"/admin\")\n    assert 'class=\"console-sidebar\"' in response.text\n    assert \">My posts<\" in response.text\n    assert \">Dashboard<\" not in response.text\n\n\ndef test_creating_an_account_shows_a_success_flash(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    new_form = admin.get(\"/admin/accounts/new\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(new_form.text)\n    response = admin.post(\n        \"/admin/accounts/new\",\n        data={\"email\": \"flash-test@example.test\", \"display_name\": \"Flash Test\",\n              \"password\": \"a-long-enough-password\", \"role\": \"editor\",\n              \"csrf_token\": token},\n        follow_redirects=True,\n    )\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"Account created.\" in response.text\n    assert 'class=\"flash\"' in response.text\n\n\ndef test_delete_confirmations_use_the_destructive_button_style(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin_user = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin_user.id)\n    post = models.create_post(\n        program_id=program.id, title=\"A post\",
