{"parentUuid":"946b9969-30b4-426c-8bcd-8668726e8ef9","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011Cfn1cj37Vh1USsLVebUqF","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01CBygjd8JWAZbuFUQ1MZSsA","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cat > /tmp/claude-1000/-home-adam-leider-code-iphs400-mp2-cms/882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d/scratchpad/issue13-comment.md << 'EOF'\n## Fix: admin console stylesheet + full shell\n\n**Root cause**, confirmed: `templates/base.html` (shared by every `templates/admin/*.html`) linked `href=\"{{ css_path | default('style.css') }}\"`, and no admin route ever passed `css_path`, so it always fell back to the literal relative string `\"style.css\"` — resolved against whatever depth the current page happens to be at, so it 404s everywhere except exactly at the server root.\n\n### Fix\n- `app/services/css_path.py`: `css_path_for(request)` computes the right number of `\"../\"` from the request's own URL depth back to one fixed route.\n- `app/routes/console.py`: new `GET /style.css`, serving a new `ADMIN_CSS` constant (`app/services/console_shell.py`) as `text/css` — the stylesheet link in every template stays relative (`href=\"{{ css_path }}\"`), never root-absolute, so `scripts/check_submission.py`'s template-wide grep for `href=\"/` stays clean.\n- `app/services/console_shell.py`'s `console_context(request, user, sidebar=None)` bundles csrf token + css path + a role-appropriate sidebar (Staff: full admin nav; Ambassador: \"My posts\" only) for every authenticated route, plus `redirect_with_flash(url, message)` — a 303 redirect carrying a one-time success message, rendered from `request.query_params` in `templates/base.html` with normal Jinja autoescaping (no `| safe`).\n- Every route in `app/routes/{auth,accounts,pages,posts,console}.py` now supplies `css_path` (pre-login) or full `console_context` (authenticated), and every successful mutating POST redirects through `redirect_with_flash`.\n- `accounts_list/edit/form.html`, `posts_list/form/delete.html`, `pages_list/form/delete.html` now extend `admin/console_base.html` (picking up the persistent sidebar that only the \"console\" screens had before) instead of `base.html` directly. `login.html`, `hello.html`, and the test-only `stub.html` deliberately keep extending `base.html` directly — no sidebar, pre-login/test-only.\n- Delete confirmations (`posts_delete.html`, `pages_delete.html`) get `class=\"btn-danger\"`. The recursive page tree (`pages_list.html`) gets `class=\"page-tree\"` so nested levels indent instead of boxing like flat rows.\n- `ADMIN_CSS` reuses the public site's Kenyon purple/gold palette and Fraunces/Inter fonts, with its own components (sidebar, plain-list \"tables\", forms, flash/alert banners) since the admin HTML is different enough from the public site's to risk rule collisions if they shared one stylesheet.\n\nA circular-import note: `console_shell.py` needs `ensure_csrf_token` from `app/routes/auth.py`, so `auth.py` imports `css_path_for` from the separate `app/services/css_path.py` instead of from `console_shell` — otherwise `auth.py` → `console_shell.py` → `auth.py` would cycle.\n\n### Review (fresh foreground subagent)\nNo blocking findings. Confirmed: `css_path_for`'s depth math is correct at every route depth tried (`/login`, `/admin`, `/admin/accounts`, `/admin/posts/{id}/edit`, `/admin/pages/{id}/edit`); no root-absolute `href`/`src` introduced anywhere in `templates/`; every `TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/...\")` call site across all 5 route modules supplies the stylesheet path; every admin `<form>` still carries its csrf token; `redirect_with_flash` URL-encodes safely and handles a redirect URL that already has a query string; the Ambassador-vs-Staff sidebar default works correctly on the templates both roles share (`posts_form.html`/`posts_list.html`). One nit: my own ticket comment said `/admin/pages/{id}/edit` was \"depth 2\" — it's actually depth 3, same shape as the posts route; harmless, since `css_path_for` computes depth from the live request path, not a hardcoded table. Added one more direct test (`test_stylesheet_resolved_from_a_nested_admin_page_returns_200`) that follows a nested page's own `<link>` href and asserts 200, for a literal match to the acceptance criteria's wording, on top of the review's suggestion.\n\n### Verification\n`uv run pytest -q` → 171 passed. `uv run python scripts/check_submission.py --stage 1` → 11/12 (the pre-existing \"no secrets in history\" failure is unrelated, out of scope). Retook all 12 required screenshots (`docs/screenshots/`) with the admin console now fully styled — sidebar, forms, lists, flash messages, destructive delete button — and confirmed each one visually at 1280 and 390 (sidebar stacks cleanly at 390, no horizontal scroll).\nEOF\ngh issue comment 13 --body-file style the full admin shell\n\nThe admin console rendered completely unstyled: templates/base.html linked\na relative \"style.css\" href that no route ever populated correctly, so it\n404'd at every depth below the server root (#13).\n\napp/services/css_path.py computes the right \"../\" depth back to a new\nGET /style.css route (app/routes/console.py), serving a new ADMIN_CSS\nconstant (app/services/console_shell.py) that reuses the public site's\nKenyon purple/gold + Fraunces/Inter language for a sidebar, forms, lists\nstanding in for tables, flash banners, and a destructive delete button.\nconsole_shell.console_context() bundles the csrf token, stylesheet path,\nand a role-appropriate sidebar for every authenticated route; every\nmutating POST now redirects through redirect_with_flash() for a one-time\nsuccess message.\n\naccounts/posts/pages' list, form, and delete templates now extend\nadmin/console_base.html instead of base.html directly, so they pick up the\npersistent sidebar that only the dashboard/content-list/metrics screens had\nbefore. login.html, hello.html, and the test-only stub.html keep extending\nbase.html directly (no sidebar, pre-login/test-only).\n\nReview findings posted on #13.\n\nCloses #13\n\nCo-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>\nEOF\n)\"\ngit push origin main","description":"Commit the admin stylesheet fix and push"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1133,"cache_read_input_tokens":449726,"output_tokens":598,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1133,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":598,"cache_read_input_tokens":449726,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1133,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1133},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01Ad78cQzdvBeReu6vrfpjau":{"command":"cd /home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms && git commit -m \"$(cat <<'EOF'\nFix admin console stylesheet; {"parentUuid":"9374f642-1dd9-48e5-ac81-7f57dc6c7e9f","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"f4ea9faf-4744-466a-b0e8-f8937753f4d6","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":" Create two GitHub issues labeled \"stretch\" and update the existing #10, each with an \"## Acceptance criteria\" section and a literal \"Blocked by:\" line. Don't implement anything yet. Show me the issue numbers when done.\n\n1. NEW: \"Tags on posts\". Blocked by: none.\n- Only Staff can create, rename and delete tags (a Tags screen in the Staff sidebar). When writing a post, Ambassadors and Staff choose tags from the existing list; Ambassadors can't create new ones.\n- Tags show on post cards and post pages. On a Program page, readers can filter posts by tag (alongside the existing topic filter). No sitewide tag pages.\n- Seed starter tags: visa, budget, homestay, travel, classes, and apply them to demo posts.\n- Tests for permissions (an Ambassador can't create tags) and the program-page filter.\n\n2. UPDATE #10 \"Site search\". Blocked by: the tags issue.\n- Keep the scoped search box on continent, country and program pages (searches only within that area), and add a sitewide search in the header.\n- Search across titles, post text and tags, with checkboxes to include any combination of the three.\n- Works on the static site: a JSON index built by cms publish, searched in the browser. Relative paths only; works at 390px.\n- Only published content is ever in the index (test this).\n\n3. NEW: \"Media uploads with alt text and cover images\". Blocked by: none.\n- Ambassadors and Staff can upload images inside posts; alt text is required before saving.\n- A post's author (Ambassador or Staff) can set that post's cover image; only Staff can set a program's cover image. Covers appear on program and post cards and at the top of post pages.\n- Ambassadors can only add or change images on their own posts, and only while the post is a draft (same edit rules as the text).\n- Uploads are validated (images only: jpg/png/webp, max size ~5 MB, safe generated filenames).\n- cms publish copies only images used by published content into site/, with relative paths.\n- Seed simple generated placeholder images (e.g. region-colored gradients with the program name) as covers and in a few posts.\n- Tests for upload validation, the alt-text requirement, permissions (an Ambassador can't set a program cover or touch someone else's post), and that draft-only images aren't published."},"uuid":"fe2e0b26-458f-4311-9f15-a5a702f0ef29","timestamp":"2026-10-07T01:41:33.143Z","permissionMode":"bypassPermissions","origin":{"kind":"human"},"promptSource":"typed","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

  image.\n- [ ] Only Staff can set a Program's cover image.\n- [ ] Cover images appear on Program and Post cards, and at the top of\n      Post pages.\n- [ ] An Ambassador can only add or change images on their own Posts, and\n      only while the Post is draft — the same edit rule that already\n      governs the Post's text.\n- [ ] Uploads are validated: images only (jpg/png/webp), a ~5 MB max size,\n      and safe generated filenames (never the original filename).\n- [ ] `cms publish` copies only images actually used by published content\n      into `site/`, with relative paths (hard constraint, every template).\n- [ ] `scripts/seed_demo.py` seeds simple generated placeholder images\n      (e.g. region-colored gradients with the Program name) as covers and\n      in a few Posts.\n- [ ] Tests cover upload validation, the alt-text requirement, permissions\n      (an Ambassador can't set a Program's cover image or touch another\n      author's Post), and that a draft's images are never published.\n\n## Blocked by\n\nBlocked by: none\nEOF\ngh issue create --title \"Media uploads with alt text and cover images\" --label \"stretch\" --body-file
